places.name: Rassada Pier (Phuket Town)
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (7.87303, 98.41454); OSM ferry_terminal node 260742667 (32 m) and terminal building way 206895809 (centre 32 m)
places.gmapsQuery: Rassada Pier, Phuket
places.description: Phuket's main ferry terminal, 3.5 km east of Old Town. Big ferries and speedboats leave here for Phi Phi, Ao Nang and Railay in Krabi, Koh Lanta and, in high season, Koh Lipe. Each boat company has its own counter inside, where you swap your ticket for a boarding pass.
places.openText: Terminal open daily about 07:30-18:00. First boats 08:30; last ferry to Phi Phi 15:00, last speedboat about 15:30.

routes.operator: Andaman Wave Master, Phi Phi Cruiser, Chaokoh, Chureang
Bundhaya, Satun Pakbara, Andaman Wave Master and others

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier) and Railay East
routes.times: Bundhaya 11:00 and 13:30 (09:00 from mid-Nov); Andaman Wave Master 08:45 (its own timetable, also to Krabi Town)

routes.operator: Ao Nang Princess (Ao Nang Travel and Tour)
routes.times: 10:30 on Sun, Wed and Fri; a daily 13:30 is added 15 Nov - 19 May
routes.duration: about 2 h (Railay 12:15, Ao Nang 12:30 on the 10:30)
routes.priceText: 850-900 THB; bags over 20 kg cost 100 THB extra
routes.season: all year; the daily 13:30 only 15 Nov - 19 May

routes.operator: Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master
routes.times: Satun Pakbara 08:30, 11:00, 12:30; Bundhaya 08:30, 10:00 (+12:00, 14:30 in high season); Andaman Wave Master 09:15

routes.to: Koh Lanta via Phi Phi (change boats at Tonsai)
routes.operator: Andaman Wave Master, Phi Phi Cruiser, Chaokoh

routes.to: Koh Lipe (Pattaya Beach), stopping at Phi Phi, Lanta, Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Kradan
routes.operator: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club, Bundhaya

places.facilities: A modern terminal with one counter per boat company, toilets, an ATM and money exchange, a few restaurants and a large car park. There is no pier fee.
places.gettingThere: From Patong 18 km over the hill: 25 min with no traffic, 40-45 min in the morning. Kamala 25 km (30-50 min), Rawai 19 km (25-40 min). The pier taxi counter asks about 700 THB to Patong; Grab and Bolt are usually cheaper, but you may have to walk out to the road to meet the car. Many ferry tickets include a shared van from Patong, Kata, Karon and Phuket Town.
places.feeText: No pier fee. Phi Phi charges 20 THB in cash when you land at Tonsai. Koh Lipe: 200 THB Tarutao park fee on arrival.
tips: Be at the counter 30-45 minutes before sailing to swap your voucher for a boarding pass and a luggage tag.
Ferries take one suitcase plus a hand bag; Andaman Wave Master charges 300 THB for each extra bag. On speedboats bags sit in a pile at the back, so use a dry bag.
If you get seasick, take the big ferry and sit low in the middle. Speedboats bounce and spray.
Tigerline and a few small boats use Chean Vanich (Chianwanich) pier, 1 km north of Rassada. Check the pier on your ticket.
The cheapest ride is the pink songthaew from Ranong Road in Old Town, 10-15 THB, about 06:30-20:00.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Andaman Wave Master's own timetable: Rassada - Tonsai 08:30 and 13:45 (700 THB), Lanta via Phi Phi 08:30 and 13:45 (November - April), speedboat 08:45 to Railay, Ao Nang and Krabi Town, 09:15 to Lanta, extra bag 300 THB. Seatran Discovery engine for 12 Jan 2027: Andaman Wave Master 08:30/13:45 and Phi Phi Cruiser 08:30/13:30, 600 THB. Direct Ferries (19 Oct - 1 Nov 2026): Chaokoh 11:00/15:00, Chureang 11:00. Lipe: ferrylipe.com (Satun Pakbara, 15 Oct 2026 - 30 Apr 2027), Bundhaya 2,500 THB to 20 May. Ao Nang Princess 10:30: Ao Nang Travel and Tour (19 Oct 2026); daily 13:30 from 15 Nov: Visit Thailand Today only (5 Oct 2026). Hours, no fee, taxi, songthaew: Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026). ATM, exchange, restaurants, car park: Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026). The 'free toilets', the 18 kg bag limit and the free Ao Nang Princess van had no source and were removed.

places.name: Chalong Pier
places.coordSource: land-end gate (meeting point): Google place via Visit Thailand Today (7.82089, 98.34433) + OSM pier way 24936612 start (57 m) + paid car park way 243583133; boats board along the 700 m jetty and at its end (OSM node 270986823)
places.gmapsQuery: Chalong Pier, Phuket
places.description: Phuket's busiest tour pier, on Chalong Bay in the south. Most speedboat day trips to Racha and Coral Island start here, plus many Phi Phi and Khai tours, dive boats and private charters. You meet your group at the gate, then walk out along the jetty (up to 700 m) to your boat.
places.openText: Gates open daily about 07:00-21:00. Most tour boats leave 08:00-09:30.

routes.to: Koh Racha Yai and Coral Island (day tours)
routes.times: hotel pickup 07:00-09:00, back at the pier 15:30-16:30
routes.priceText: Racha + Coral tour from about 1,300 THB per person
routes.season: all year, calmest November to April

routes.to: Koh Racha Yai (The Racha resort guests)
Phi Phi, Maya Bay and Khai Islands (day tours)
routes.duration: Phi Phi about 1 h each way
routes.priceText: Phi Phi tours about 1,500-3,500 THB per person
routes.season: all year (Maya Bay closed 1 Aug - 30 Sep)

places.facilities: Tour company desks and dive shops along the access road, a paid car park, and seafood restaurants by the gate (Kan Eang is 90 m away). The jetty has very little shade.
places.gettingThere: From Rawai 6 km (10-15 min), Patong 17 km over the hill (20-40 min), Kamala 26 km (30-50 min). Grab or Bolt from Kata to Chalong is about 200-300 THB (Aug 2026). Most tours include the van from your hotel.
places.feeText: No passenger fee found; car parking is paid. Racha and Coral Island have no park fee.
tips: Ask which pier your tour uses: Chalong, Rawai, Rassada, Ao Po and Royal Phuket Marina are all used.
The walk out along the jetty can take up to 10 minutes. Arrive on time: tour boats do not wait.
Bring a hat and sun cream: you wait and board in full sun.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026): gates 07:00-21:00, very little shade, Kan Eang about 90 m. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): busiest tour pier, Racha, Coral and Phi Phi tours, The Racha 13:00 transfer, large car park. Phuket 101 Khai page (29 Aug 2026): Khai tours from Chalong. Tisland (Oct 2026): Racha + Coral from 1,300 THB, pickup 07:00-09:00. OSM: jetty 696 m, paid car park. Grab fare evephuket (Aug 2026). OSRM: Patong 16.6 km, Kamala 26.5 km, Rawai 6.0 km.

places.name: Rawai Pier (longtail boats)
places.coordSource: land end of the pier on Rawai beach: OSM pier ways 142750665/808089242 start (7.77500, 98.32755, 12 m) + Commons photo geotag of the 'Rawai Landing Pier' sign (7.77506, 98.32760); OSM ferry_terminal node 1562225016 is at the sea end, 330 m south
places.gmapsQuery: Rawai Pier, Phuket
places.description: A 300 m concrete pier on Rawai beach at Phuket's southern tip. Longtail captains wait on the beach and rent the whole boat: Koh Bon, Coral Island and Koh Lone are 15-20 minutes away. Cheaper than a packaged tour for a group, but simple: no terminal and no fixed timetable.

routes.season: all year, best November to April

routes.priceText: about 1,000-2,200 THB per boat, return (agree first)

places.facilities: No terminal. Seafood restaurants and the Rawai seafood market are along the beach road.
places.gettingThere: From Kata or Nai Harn 10-15 min, Patong 20 km (25-40 min), Kamala 30 km (35-55 min). Grab or Bolt from Kata to Rawai is about 200-300 THB (Aug 2026). The Smart Bus Route 1 ends at Rawai (100 THB).
places.feeText: No pier fee. Coral Island and Koh Bon have no park fee.
tips: Agree the price, the return time and fuel before you get in, and pay at the end.
Ask for life jackets for everyone before you leave the beach.
Go in the morning: the afternoon wind makes the ride wet.
Phuket 101 lists Koh Maiton as closed to visitors in 2026: check before you pay for a trip there.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): Koh Bon about 15 min, Coral 15-20 min, Racha 30-45 min, prices agreed with the drivers. Phuket 101 islands guide (4 Oct 2026, prices checked Jul 2026): Coral 1,500-2,000 THB per boat, Koh Bon 1,000 (text) to 1,800-2,200 (table), Racha no public boat, Maiton 'Suspended'; the Maiton page (Mar 2026) says access is suspended until further notice, so the tip now says to check rather than 'do not pay'. Pier 335 m in OSM. OSRM: Patong 20.3 km, Kamala 30.2 km.

places.name: Ao Po Pier (Ao Por)
places.coordSource: land end of the 500 m public jetty: OSM pier way 55868243 start (8.06146, 98.43209, 30 m); same spot as the guide's existing 'Directions to Ao Po Pier' (8.06094, 98.43294, 60 m). Boats board at the pontoon 500 m out (OSM node 701552280)
places.gmapsQuery: Ao Po Pier, Pa Khlok, Phuket
places.description: The long public jetty at Ao Po on the north-east coast, facing Phang Nga Bay. Many Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island tours board here, including John Gray's Sea Canoe. Tour vans stop at the land end; the boats wait at the pontoon at the end of the 500 m jetty.

routes.to: Phang Nga Bay, James Bond Island and Hong islands (tours)
routes.operator: John Gray's Sea Canoe and other tour companies
routes.priceText: about 1,400-3,950 THB per person with transfer

places.facilities: A basic public pier. For cafes and restaurants, Ao Po Grand Marina is 1.3 km north-east.
places.gettingThere: From Kamala 29 km (35-55 min), Patong 36 km (45-70 min), Rawai 42 km (50-75 min), the airport or Nai Yang 20 km (25-35 min). Tours include hotel pickup. Grab or Bolt from Patong: about the same distance as airport - Patong, which is 570-850 THB on the apps (Aug 2026).
places.feeText: No pier fee. Phang Nga Bay park fee 300 THB (child 150), usually included in tours.
tips: Ao Po Pier and Ao Po Grand Marina are different places, 1.3 km apart. Check your voucher.
Sea-canoe tours follow the tide, so the order of stops can change on the day.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. John Gray's Sea Canoe (official): trips leave from Ao Po, pickup 10:20-11:15, from 3,950 THB. Park fee 300/150 THB: Siam Tour (20 Aug 2026), Simba Sea Trips (May 2026), Phuket 101 islands guide (4 Oct 2026). OSM: jetty 517 m from land end to pontoon. The claim that you walk 500 m out had no source and was reworded. OSRM: Kamala 29.3 km, Patong 36.2 km, Rawai 42.3 km, airport 20.0 km.

places.name: Ao Po Grand Marina
places.coordSource: Google place (as in the guide's ao-po area: 1 m) next to the OSM slipway and Port of Call restaurant (OSM way 1470100750, 70 m); OSM marina node 2505243405 sits on the outer pontoons, 340 m E
places.gmapsQuery: Ao Po Grand Marina, Phuket
places.description: Phuket's superyacht marina, 1.3 km north-east of the public Ao Po pier, at the gateway to Phang Nga Bay. Premium tours, yacht and catamaran charters and resort boats leave here, for example to Six Senses on Koh Yao Noi and Santhiya on Koh Yao Yai. Cafes and bars make it a pleasant place to wait.

routes.season: listed in Oct 2026; check before you book

routes.operator: yacht and catamaran charter companies based here

places.facilities: Restaurants and bars (Port of Call, D Deck), a pool, a gym and yacht services.
places.gettingThere: From Kamala 30 km (40-60 min), Patong 37 km (45-70 min), Rawai 43 km (55-80 min), the airport or Nai Yang 21 km (about 30 min). Grab or Bolt from Patong: about the same distance as airport - Patong, which is 570-850 THB on the apps (Aug 2026).
places.feeText: No passenger fee. Park fees depend on the trip.
tips: If your boat is late, wait at Port of Call or D Deck rather than on the dock.
Charter companies here quote by the boat, so a group of 8 can split the price.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Official site: 230-berth superyacht marina, eateries, bars, fitness and pool, 24-hour access for boats (no parking or passenger services listed, so 'parking' and 'open 24 hours' were removed). Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026): Port of Call, D Deck, Six Senses guests leave here. Six Senses transfer sheet: 40 min by boat. Santhiya about 20 min: Visit Thailand Today (18 Oct 2026). Phi Phi Logistic 11:30 out and 14:00 back, about 1,600 THB: Visit Thailand Today (6 Oct 2026); Expedia listings about USD 55-57. OSRM distances.

places.name: Bang Rong Pier
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.04947, 98.41591) + OSM ferry_terminal node 485657809 (24 m); same as the guide's 'Directions to Bang Rong Pier'
places.gmapsQuery: Bang Rong Pier, Phuket
places.description: A small pier on the north-east coast and the main stop for public boats to Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai: speedboats in 30-40 minutes, a slow longtail in about an hour. A few speedboats go on across the bay to Ao Nang and Railay. It is the closest pier to the airport.
places.openText: Open 24 hours, but boats run only by day: about 08:30-17:00.

routes.operator: Koh Yao King Marine, Supaporn, Green Planet

routes.to: Koh Yao Yai (Chong Lard or Klong Hia Pier)
routes.operator: Koh Yao Sun Smile, Suwimol, Solomon, Green Planet

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier) and Railay East, via Koh Yao
routes.operator: Koh Yao Sun Smile, Green Planet
routes.season: all year (more boats in high season)

places.facilities: Ticket counters, a small waiting area, a few food stalls, toilets and a car and motorbike park.
places.gettingThere: From the airport or Nai Yang 17 km (20-30 min). Kamala 25 km (30-45 min), Patong 32 km (35-55 min), Rawai 38 km (45-70 min). Grab or Bolt: expect roughly 500-800 THB from the west coast (the 35 km airport - Patong ride is 570-850 THB on the apps, Aug 2026).
places.feeText: No pier fee found. Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai have no island fee.
tips: The last boats leave about 17:00. A late-afternoon flight into Phuket can miss them.
Arrive 15 minutes early and buy the ticket at the counter, or book online a day ahead.
Some Koh Yao resorts send their own boat and car from the airport via Bang Rong: ask them first.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Camphadee timetable (2 Nov 2025): Bang Rong 08:40-17:00, longtail 12:30, 400/300 THB. Ferryscanner (25 Sep 2026): Green Planet, Koh Yao King Marine, Supaporn, first 08:40, last 17:00; Koh Yao Yai 08:30-17:00. bangrongpier.com: 09:30, 11:00, 13:30, 17:00 to Chong Lard (550 THB) and 09:30, 11:00, 15:00 to Ao Nang (1,000-1,200 THB). Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026): open 24 hours, last boats about 17:00. Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026): counters, waiting area, food stalls. OSRM: airport 16.6 km, Kamala 24.7, Patong 31.6, Rawai 37.7.

places.name: Laem Hin Pier
places.coordSource: land end of the 330 m pier (where the tour office and Laem Hin Seafood are): OSM pier way 243077747 end (7.93600, 98.40711); Laem Hin Seafood (OSM, Nominatim) 42 m; the OSM ferry_terminal node 2505166441 is at the sea end, 330 m east. In tambon Ko Kaeo, not Phuket Town
places.gmapsQuery: Laem Hin Pier, Phuket
places.description: A small pier on the east coast, about 15 minutes north of Phuket Town, next to the popular Laem Hin Seafood restaurant. A Green Planet speedboat leaves at 13:00 for Koh Yao Yai, Koh Yao Noi and Ao Nang, longtails go to Koh Maphrao and Rang Yai, and some Khai Islands tours start here.

routes.to: Koh Yao Yai (Klong Hia) and Koh Yao Noi (Manoh)
routes.times: 13:00 and 14:00 (2026 listings); back from Klong Hia 10:50

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier), via Koh Yao

routes.operator: longtail captains and the tour office at the pier
routes.priceText: about 2,500 THB per boat, return with waiting time

places.facilities: A small tour office in front of the pier, Laem Hin Seafood on the waterfront and two floating seafood restaurants in the channel.
places.gettingThere: From Phuket Town 9 km (15-25 min), Patong 21 km (25-45 min), Kamala 23 km (30-50 min), Rawai 23 km (30-50 min). Grab or Bolt from Patong costs a bit more than Patong - Phuket Town (300-400 THB on the apps, Aug 2026).
places.feeText: No pier fee found.
tips: Green Planet passengers check in on the pier at least 30 minutes before: look for the Green Planet sign.
Good lunch stop after a Khai or Koh Yao day: Laem Hin Seafood is busy with locals at weekends.

links.label: Laem Hin - Koh Yao Yai boats (Ferryscanner)

places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com Green Planet listing: Laem Hin 13:00 to Nopparat Thara 14:30 via Klong Hia and Manoh, 1,000 THB, check in 30 min before at the Green Planet sign. Visit Thailand Today (5 Oct 2026): Green Planet 13:00 from Laem Hin, 1,000 THB. Ferryscanner (2026): Laem Hin - Klong Hia by Green Planet only, first 13:00, last 14:00, back 10:50, from EUR 8.71. The old 'a few a day, 08:30-17:00' were Bang Rong times; the 650 THB fare and 'parking is limited' had no source. Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026): Rang Yai, Koh Maphrao, tour office, restaurants. Pin moved to the land end; area set to koh-kaew (tambon Ko Kaeo).

places.name: Royal Phuket Marina
places.coordSource: Google Maps link on the official royalphuketmarina.com contact page (!3d7.9667795!4d98.3907544); OSM marina node 2504564145 (90 m). Boat Lagoon marina pontoons (OSM) are 450 m west. In tambon Ko Kaeo, 3.7 km outside the guide's phuket-town area
places.gmapsQuery: Royal Phuket Marina, Phuket
places.description: A marina on the east coast north of Phuket Town. Several premium tour companies, such as Simba Sea Trips, start Phang Nga Bay, Phi Phi and Khai trips here, and private yachts and speedboats can be chartered. Many tours serve breakfast here before you board. Boat Lagoon marina is next door.

routes.to: Phang Nga Bay, Phi Phi and Khai Islands (tours)
routes.operator: Simba Sea Trips and other premium tour companies

places.facilities: Restaurants, a coffee shop, toilets and covered waiting areas.
places.gettingThere: From Patong 21 km (25-40 min), Kamala 19 km (25-45 min), Rawai 27 km (35-50 min), the airport 24 km (35-45 min). Tours include hotel pickup. Grab or Bolt from Patong costs a bit more than Patong - Phuket Town (300-400 THB on the apps, Aug 2026).
places.feeText: No passenger fee. Park fees depend on the trip (Phi Phi 400 THB, Phang Nga Bay 300 THB).
tips: Boat Lagoon is the marina next door: check which one your voucher names.
For a private boat for the group of 8, ask charter companies here and at Chalong for quotes.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Official site: map link 7.9667795, 98.3907544 and og:image. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): Simba Sea Trips and others, Phang Nga, Phi Phi and Similan tours, private charters, restaurants, coffee shop, toilets, covered waiting areas, breakfast before departure, Boat Lagoon next door. Phuket 101 Khai page (29 Aug 2026): Khai tours from Royal Phuket Marina. Area changed from phuket-town to koh-kaew: the pin is 3.7 km outside the phuket-town polygon. OSRM: Patong 20.6 km, Kamala 19.4, Rawai 26.8, airport 24.1.

places.name: Thap Lamu Pier (Khao Lak, for the Similan Islands)
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.57013, 98.22324) + OSM ferry_terminal node 2466095538 (3 m); same as the guide's existing Similan directions. Love Andaman Pier (OSM way 764568204) 90 m; park office (OSM way 438927105) 700 m east
places.gmapsQuery: Tap Lamu Pier, Thai Mueang, Phang Nga
places.description: A working pier 15 km south of Khao Lak, where nearly all Similan day trips start. Vans bring you here, you check in at your company's desk at about 08:00, and speedboats or catamarans leave for the islands, about 70 km out, soon after. Day trips come back at 16:30-17:30.
places.openText: Similan boats run only while the park is open: 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027.

routes.operator: Similan day-trip companies (sold by Tisland and others)
routes.times: check-in about 08:00, boats leave soon after; back at 16:30-17:30
routes.duration: 1 h 15 min - 1 h 30 min each way
routes.priceText: about 2,500-3,800 THB per person from Phuket, with transfer, lunch and park fee

places.facilities: Operator desks, a few cafes and the boats; some companies, such as Love Andaman, have their own small piers here. The Similan park office is 700 m east.
places.gettingThere: About 100 km from Patong (1.5-2 h), 90 km from Kamala, 111 km from Rawai, 71 km from the airport (about 70 min). Tours pick up in Phuket from about 05:30. The airport limousine counter charges 1,600 THB per car to Thap Lamu.
places.feeText: Similan park fee 500 THB adult, 250 child; included in most tours or collected at the pier.
tips: Only 3,325 day visitors a day are allowed: book January trips well ahead.
Sleeping one night in Khao Lak saves the 05:30 pickup and 3-4 hours of driving.
Take a seasickness pill before the 1.5-hour open-sea crossing, even in calm January.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today Thap Lamu page (Oct 2026): Khao Lak pickups 06:30-07:30, Phuket from 05:30, check-in about 08:00, crossing 1 h 15 - 1 h 30 to islands about 70 km out, back 16:30-17:30, fee included or collected at the pier, desks and a few cafes, season 15 Oct - 15 May. Visit Thailand Today Phuket - Khao Lak (7 Oct 2026): limousine 1,600 THB to Thap Lamu, closure 16 May - 15 Oct 2026. Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027 and quota 3,325 day visitors + 525 divers: Tisland and news (2026). Fee 500/250: Siam Tour (Aug 2026). Love Andaman pier and park office: OSM. OSRM: Patong 101.8 km, Kamala 90.5, Rawai 110.9, airport 71.3.

places.name: Klong Jilad Pier (Krabi Town)
places.coordSource: between the OSM 'Passenger Port of Krabi' terminal building (8.04780, 98.90745, 120 m) and the jetty head / OSM ferry_terminal node 260742650 (8.04585, 98.90586, 160 m); Commons photo geotag 8.04477, 98.90467
places.gmapsQuery: Klong Jilad Pier, Krabi
places.description: Krabi Town's passenger port, 3 km south of the centre. Big ferries leave here for Koh Phi Phi several times a day, and from November to April also boats to Koh Lanta. If you stay in Ao Nang or Railay, use Nopparat Thara pier or Railay East instead: it saves the drive.

routes.operator: ferry companies (Andaman Wave Master and others; also sold by Seatran Discovery and 12Go)

places.facilities: A passenger terminal building and car parks.
places.gettingThere: From Krabi Town centre 3 km (about 10 min); from Ao Nang 19 km (25-40 min). Many ferry tickets include a van from Krabi Town or Ao Nang hotels.
places.feeText: No pier fee found. Phi Phi charges 20 THB on arrival.
tips: From Ao Nang or Railay, the boats from Nopparat Thara or Railay East are closer than Klong Jilad.

links.label: Seatran Discovery booking (sells Krabi - Phi Phi)
Krabi - Phi Phi ferry (Andaman Wave Master)

places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Seatran Discovery engine for 12 Jan 2027: Klong Jilad - Tonsai 09:00, 10:30, 13:30, 450 THB, 2 h. Andaman Wave Master's own timetable: Krabi - Phi Phi 09:00 and 13:00, 450 THB. Visit Thailand Today Krabi - Lanta (3 Oct 2026, December snapshot): Lanta Super Concord ferry 11:00 to 13:45 (516 THB), Satun Pakbara speedboat 08:50 (945-1,008 THB) and Andaman Wave Master 09:40 (1,150 THB), Klong Jilad boats only November - April. The old route called the 09:40 boat a ferry; it is a speedboat. OSRM: Krabi Town 2.9 km, Ao Nang 18.8 km.

places.name: Nopparat Thara Pier (Ao Nang)
places.coordSource: OSM ferry_terminal node 2495732193 'Noppharat Thara Pier' and its jetty way 241997639 (within 20 m); Ao Nang longtail cooperative ticket booth (OSM) 200 m SE
places.gmapsQuery: Nopparat Thara Pier, Ao Nang, Krabi
places.description: The ferry and speedboat pier at the west end of Ao Nang, by Nopparat Thara beach. Boats leave for Phuket, Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Yao and, in high season, Koh Lipe. It is a few km from central Ao Nang: a tuk-tuk costs about 200 baht.

routes.to: Phuket (Rassada, Bang Rong or Laem Hin)
routes.operator: Green Planet, Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master, Koh Yao Sun Smile
routes.times: about 10:00-14:00 (Oct 2026; more boats in high season)

routes.operator: Ao Nang Princess (Ao Nang Travel and Tour)
routes.times: 15:00 on Sun, Wed and Fri; a daily 10:30 is added 15 Nov - 19 May
routes.season: all year; the daily 10:30 only 15 Nov - 19 May

routes.operator: Ao Nang Travel and Tour (ferry), Bundhaya (speedboat)
routes.priceText: ferry about 650 THB, speedboat about 1,000 THB

routes.operator: Bundhaya; from November also Andaman Wave Master and the Ao Nang Princess
routes.times: Bundhaya 10:10 (also 13:00 and 14:40 in December listings); Andaman Wave Master 10:00; Ao Nang Princess 10:30 from 15 Nov
routes.season: all year; more boats November to April

routes.to: Koh Yao Noi (Manoh) and Koh Yao Yai (Klong Hia)

places.facilities: A basic pier. The Ao Nang longtail cooperative has a ticket booth next to it.
places.gettingThere: From central Ao Nang 2-4 km: tuk-tuk about 200 THB. Many boat tickets include a hotel van.
places.feeText: No pier fee found. Phi Phi charges 20 THB on arrival; Hong Islands tours pay 300 THB park fee.
tips: Boats land here, not in the middle of Ao Nang beach: plan the tuk-tuk ride.
Speedboats are wet in any swell: pack bags in a dry bag or a bin bag.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. places.name: Railay East floating pier
places.coordSource: between the Google place 'Floating Pier (East Railay)' via Visit Thailand Today (8.00991, 98.84216, 95 m) and the OSM ferry_terminal node 265688020 'Railay East pier' (8.00922, 98.84392, 110 m)
places.gmapsQuery: Floating Pier East Railay, Krabi
places.description: The floating pier on the mangrove side of Railay, where ferries and speedboats from Phuket and Phi Phi stop. Railay has no road, so everyone arrives by boat. From the pier it is a short walk to West Railay beach, and longtails cross to Ao Nam Mao on the mainland.
places.openText: Daily about 08:00-18:00.

routes.to: Phuket (Rassada, Laem Hin or Bang Rong)
routes.operator: Green Planet, Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master, Ao Nang Princess
routes.times: speedboats about 09:20-14:00; Ao Nang Princess 15:15 on Sun, Wed and Fri (more sailings 15 Nov - 19 May)

routes.operator: Ao Nang Travel and Tour (ferry) and speedboat companies
Bundhaya; November to April also Satun Pakbara, Andaman Wave Master, Koh Yao Sun Smile and the Ao Nang Princess
routes.times: Bundhaya 10:30 (also 13:20 and 15:00 in December listings); others about 08:35-12:00
routes.season: all year; more boats November to April

routes.to: Ao Nam Mao (mainland, for Krabi Town)
routes.priceText: about 100 THB per person, 150 after sunset

places.facilities: Only the floating pontoon. A tractor trailer sometimes carries people and bags across the shallow water.
places.gettingThere: Boat only. Walk from West Railay beach in about 10 minutes.
places.feeText: No pier fee found.
tips: Bring a backpack, not a hard suitcase: the floating jetty moves.
Go early: more boats and less queue in the morning.
Longtails cost more after sunset, so plan the last ride.

places.name: Tonsai Pier (Koh Phi Phi Don)
places.coordSource: OSM pier way 407741133 'Koh Phi Phi Ton Sai Pier' (centre 7.73785, 98.77073, 6 m) and ferry_terminal node 3233091096 (50 m); Commons photo geotag (Jan 2025) 7.73844, 98.77095
places.gmapsQuery: Ton Sai Pier, Koh Phi Phi
places.description: The main pier of Koh Phi Phi Don, in Tonsai village. Almost all ferries and speedboats from Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay, Lanta and Lipe land here. There are no cars on the island: you walk, or a porter pushes your bags on a cart. Pay the 20-baht island fee as you step off.

routes.operator: Phi Phi Cruiser, Chaokoh, Andaman Wave Master, Chureang
Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master and other speedboats

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara) and Railay East

routes.times: Andaman Wave Master 11:30 and 15:30 (Nov-Apr); Chaokoh 15:00 (at Lanta 16:00); Satun Pakbara 09:30 and 13:30
routes.season: all year; more boats November to April

places.facilities: Boat company ticket desks near the pier; Tonsai village around it has shops, cafes and hotels. Porters with carts charge about 100 THB.
places.gettingThere: Boat only. Most Tonsai and Loh Dalum hotels are a 5-15 minute walk from the pier.
places.feeText: 20 THB per person, cash, on arrival (pier cleaning fee). Maya Bay and Phi Phi Le tours pay the park fee: 400 THB (child 200).
tips: Keep a 20-baht note ready as you walk off the boat.
The last ferry to Phuket is 15:30 and the last speedboat about 17:00.
Agree the porter price (about 100 baht) before he loads your bags.

places.name: Saladan Pier (Koh Lanta)

routes.to: Koh Lipe, via Koh Ngai, Koh Mook and Koh Kradan

tips: In December and January the car-ferry queue can add hours by road, so the boat is faster.

places.name: Manoh Pier (Koh Yao Noi)
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.09365, 98.58705) + OSM ferry_terminal node 2415555147 (19 m)
places.gmapsQuery: Manoh Pier, Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga
places.description: The main pier of Koh Yao Noi, on the south-west coast. Public speedboats and longtails from Bang Rong on Phuket land here after 30-60 minutes. Shared taxis and hotel drivers wait at the end of the jetty, and longtails cross to Chong Lard pier on Koh Yao Yai in about 10 minutes.

routes.priceText: speedboat about 400 THB, longtail about 300 THB

routes.operator: Bundhaya, Green Planet and other through speedboats (some call here)
routes.duration: about 40 min to Ao Nang, 1 h 10 min to Rassada
routes.priceText: Bundhaya 650 THB to Ao Nang, 550 THB to Rassada
routes.season: mostly mid-Oct to early May (Bundhaya to 4 May)

places.facilities: Shared taxis and hotel drivers wait at the end of the jetty.
places.gettingThere: Boat only: 30-40 min by speedboat from Bang Rong pier on Phuket.
places.feeText: No pier or island fee.
tips: The last boat back to Phuket leaves at about 16:00.
For Krabi, wooden boats leave from Tha Khao pier on the north-east coast (about 40 min to Ao Thalane, 120-150 THB), not from Manoh.
Bring enough cash: ATMs on the island can run out at weekends.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today Tha Khao page (Oct 2026): wooden boats to Ao Thalane, about 40 min, 120-150 THB (Camphadee also lists 300 THB speedboats). ATM tip: Phuket 101 (Aug 2026).

places.name: Chong Lard Pier (Koh Yao Yai)
places.coordSource: OSM ferry_terminal node 1029806558 'Chong Lard Pier'; Klong Hia Pier (OSM way 50425253) is 2.5 km west at 8.08546, 98.56415
places.gmapsQuery: Chong Lard Pier, Koh Yao Yai, Phang Nga
places.description: A small pier at the north-east tip of Koh Yao Yai, facing Koh Yao Noi. Speedboats from Bang Rong on Phuket land here, and longtails cross to Manoh pier on Koh Yao Noi in about 10 minutes. Klong Hia, the other main pier, is 2.5 km west and gets boats from Bang Rong, Laem Hin and Ao Nang.

routes.operator: Koh Yao Sun Smile, Suwimol, Solomon
routes.times: first about 06:30; last boats about 16:00 (16:10 from Klong Hia)

routes.to: Phuket (Laem Hin) and Ao Nang, from Klong Hia Pier

places.facilities: Basic. Taxis are not always waiting, so ask your hotel to meet the boat.
places.gettingThere: Boat only: about 30 min from Bang Rong pier on Phuket.
places.feeText: No pier or island fee.
tips: Ask your hotel which pier is closer: Chong Lard (north-east) or Klong Hia (north-west).
There is no regular public transport: scooters cost about 250-350 THB a day.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. places.name: Koh Lipe arrival point (Pattaya Beach)
places.coordSource: OSM ferry_terminal node 5425777804 'Ko Lipe' on Pattaya Beach; Bundhaya Resort (boat check-in area, OSM node 1058873129) 70 m; boats tie up at a floating platform or anchor offshore
places.gmapsQuery: Pattaya Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun
places.description: Koh Lipe has no big pier. Boats from Phuket, Lanta, Pak Bara and Langkawi tie up at a floating platform or anchor off Pattaya Beach, and longtails take you and your bags to the sand. Expect wet feet. The island is in Tarutao National Park, so everyone pays the park fee on arrival.

routes.to: Phuket (Rassada), via Lanta and Phi Phi
routes.operator: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club, Bundhaya

places.facilities: Walking Street, with shops, restaurants and a 7-Eleven, starts at Pattaya Beach. No cars: motorbike sidecars cost about 50 THB per person.
places.gettingThere: Only by boat: about 5 h by direct speedboat from Phuket in high season, or 1 h 30 min from Pak Bara all year.
places.feeText: Tarutao National Park fee 200 THB adult, 100 child, cash on arrival; keep the ticket. Divers pay 200 THB more per diving day. Longtail from the boat to the beach about 50 THB per person.
tips: Pack electronics in a dry bag: the longtail transfer is often wet.
From May to October only the Pak Bara boats run.
Lipe is too far for a day trip from Phuket: plan at least 3 nights.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. places.name: Pak Bara Pier (Satun)
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (6.86040, 99.72241); OSM tourism node 4524958404 'Pak Bara Pier' (41 m)
places.gmapsQuery: Pak Bara Pier, La-ngu, Satun
places.description: The mainland pier in Satun province for Koh Lipe and the Tarutao islands, and the only way to Lipe that runs all year. Most people come on a van and boat ticket from Hat Yai, about 2.5 hours by road. Only useful if you go to Lipe outside the season of the direct Phuket speedboat.

routes.priceText: about 250 THB (van + boat ticket about 950 THB)

places.facilities: Ticket offices of the boat companies, including Satun Pakbara's office, and a tourist service centre.
places.gettingThere: From Hat Yai airport about 2.5 h by van. From Phuket it is a full day by road, so use the direct Phuket - Lipe speedboat in season.
places.feeText: Tarutao park fee 200 THB, paid here or on arrival on Lipe.
tips: In the rainy season the crossing can be rough, and boats are sometimes combined or late.
places.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today Pak Bara page (Oct 2026): Bundhaya 11:30 and 13:30 (+09:30 from December), back 09:30/11:30/13:30, 1 h 30, 700 THB, Hat Yai van + boat 950 THB, park fee 200 THB at the pier or on Lipe. places.name: Bangrak piers: Lomprayah and Big Buddha (Koh Samui)

places.gmapsQuery: Big Buddha Pier, Bang Rak, Koh Samui
places.description: A group of piers at the west end of Bangrak bay on Koh Samui, near the Big Buddha and 5-10 minutes from Samui airport. Lomprayah boats leave here for Thong Sala about every hour, the Haad Rin Queen goes straight to Haad Rin, and Songserm Express and Echo Travel use Petcherat Marina next door.

routes.priceText: 350 THB (500 with a Samui hotel pickup)

routes.to: Koh Phangan (Thong Sala), van from Samui airport included
routes.priceText: 500 THB (400 on the 11:45; 700 to your Phangan hotel)

routes.to: Haad Rin (Koh Phangan), from the Big Buddha pier
routes.season: all year; extra night speedboats on Full Moon nights

routes.to: Koh Phangan (Thong Sala), from Petcherat Marina
Koh Phangan (Baan Tai pier), from Petcherat Marina
routes.season: listed on 12Go and Ferryscanner in 2026; its own website was offline in Oct 2026, so check before you rely on it

places.facilities: Ticket desks, drink and snack vendors, little shade. Shared vans to Chaweng and the airport cost about 100 THB per person.
places.gettingThere: From Samui airport 3-4 km (5-10 min): Grab or inDrive about 220-280 THB, but walk out to the main road by the 7-Eleven to meet the car. From Chaweng about 10-15 min.
places.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: Seatran's pier is about 900 m east by road: your ticket names the pier.
Lomprayah's luggage limit is 20 kg per person; heavier bags are charged at the desk.
Haad Rin Queen tickets: the Big Buddha pier desk (cash), its own website or the Seatran Discovery site.
From the airport, take a boat leaving 90-120 minutes after your landing time.

places.description: Seatran Discovery's pier (Bangrak Tourism Port) on the east side of Bangrak bay, about 900 m by road from the Lomprayah pier and 5 minutes from Samui airport. Seatran's fast ferries go to Thong Sala on Koh Phangan and on to Koh Tao, and Boonsiri catamarans also leave from here.

routes.to: Koh Phangan (Thong Sala), van from Samui airport included

places.facilities: Seatran's ticket office and check-in counter.

places.feeText: No pier fee.

places.gmapsQuery: Lomprayah Pralarn Pier, Maenam, Koh Samui

routes.to: Koh Phangan to Pralarn (the way back)

places.facilities: Lomprayah check-in and ticket office.
places.gettingThere: From Samui airport 13.5 km (20-30 min); from Maenam hotels a few minutes.
places.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: If you fly out of Samui, choose a boat to Bangrak: it is 5-10 minutes from the airport, Pralarn 20-30.

places.name: Nathon Pier (Koh Samui)
places.coordSource: OSM 'Nathon Pier Ko Samui' ferry_terminal node 10744725265 (26 m) and pier way 320110875 (40 m); Lomprayah Nathon terminal node 4775993796 (130 m); Seatran car-ferry pier (OSM node 2467345103) 230 m north
places.gmapsQuery: Nathon Pier, Koh Samui
places.description: The old town pier in Nathon, on Samui's west coast. Lomprayah catamarans from Donsak on the mainland, including the Phuket bus and boat ticket, stop here, and boats leave for Koh Phangan and Koh Tao. Seatran's car ferry from Donsak uses its own pier 250 m north.

routes.times: Songserm ferry 10:30; Lomprayah 12:15 and 16:00; Boonsiri 14:35; Songserm Express 17:15

routes.to: Donsak (mainland), from the Seatran car-ferry pier

places.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: The Lomprayah Phuket bus and boat ticket stops here at 15:45 before going on to Thong Sala.

places.name: Raja Ferry Lipa Noi Pier (Koh Samui)
places.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (9.48168, 99.92555) + OSM 'Raja Ferry Lipa Noi Pier' ferry_terminal node 4703394110 (15 m)
places.gmapsQuery: Raja Ferry Lipa Noi Pier, Koh Samui
places.description: Raja Ferry's car-ferry pier on Samui's west coast. Big, slow car ferries cross to Donsak on the mainland every hour, and many cheap bus and ferry tickets to Surat Thani, Krabi and Phuket use them. You only come here on such a ticket or with a car.

routes.times: every hour 05:00-19:00 (extra boats 30 Dec - 30 Apr when cars queue)

places.gettingThere: From Samui airport 33 km (about 40-50 min).
places.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: Raja's own site no longer lists a Lipa Noi - Koh Phangan sailing (Oct 2026): use the Bangrak boats for Phangan.

facts.title: Which pier for which island
facts.text: Phi Phi, Ao Nang, Railay, Koh Lanta and Koh Lipe: Rassada Pier near Phuket Town (a few Krabi speedboats leave Bang Rong or Laem Hin). Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai: Bang Rong (or Laem Hin). Racha and Coral Island: Chalong, or a longtail from Rawai. Phang Nga Bay: Ao Po, Royal Phuket Marina or Bang Rong. Similan: Thap Lamu in Khao Lak, 1.5-2 hours by road. Tours choose the pier, so read the voucher.

facts.title: How to book boats
facts.text: Book on the company's own site (Lomprayah, Seatran Discovery, Bundhaya, Satun Pakbara, Andaman Wave Master) or on 12Go, Klook or Ferryscanner, which add a small fee. The Haad Rin Queen sells at its pier desk, on its own site and through Seatran Discovery; Rawai longtails only on the beach, in cash. In January book 2-3 days ahead, and a week ahead around the Full Moon (Fri 22 Jan) and the day after.

facts.title: E-ticket or voucher
facts.text: Most online bookings give you a voucher or a QR code, not a boarding pass. At the pier, show it and your passport at the company's counter: you get a boarding pass or a sticker and a coloured luggage tag. A 12Go ticket marked e-ticket may need no swap. Be there 30-45 minutes early and save every ticket offline.

links.label: Rassada Pier check-in (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

facts.title: Hotel pickup for boats and tours
facts.text: Many ferry and tour tickets include a shared van from Patong, Kata, Karon, Rawai, Nai Harn and Phuket Town. Kamala, Surin, Bang Tao and Nai Yang usually cost about 150 THB per person each way (some sellers also charge it for Rawai and Nai Harn). Mai Khao, Layan and Nai Thon may need a private car, about 2,000 THB return. The van collects other hotels too, so be in the lobby 10 minutes early.

facts.title: Boats that run only in high season
facts.text: These run in January but not all year: the Phuket - Lanta - Koh Ngai - Koh Mook - Koh Lipe speedboats (15 Oct 2026 - 30 Apr 2027, Bundhaya to 20 May), the big ferries Phuket - Phi Phi - Lanta and the Krabi Town - Lanta boats (November to April), the daily 13:30 Ao Nang Princess from Rassada (15 Nov - 19 May) and all Similan trips (15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027).

facts.title: Speedboat or big ferry
facts.text: Speedboats are twice as fast (Phi Phi in 1 hour, not 2) but they bounce, spray and pile bags at the back. Big ferries roll much less and have seats inside. If you get seasick, take the ferry and sit low in the middle; on a speedboat sit at the back. Take a seasickness pill 30-60 minutes before you leave.

links.label: Phuket to Phi Phi boats (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

facts.title: Safety on boats
facts.text: Boats in Thailand can sink or collide, mostly because of overloading, poor maintenance or rough seas (UK travel advice). Use known companies, do not board a boat that looks overloaded, and wear the life jacket on speedboats and longtails. Keep your phone and passport in a dry bag.

facts.title: January sea and cancellations
facts.text: On the Andaman side (Phuket, Phi Phi, Krabi, Similan) January is calm and dry, so cancellations are rare. In the Gulf (Samui, Phangan) the north-east monsoon can raise 2-4 m waves until about early January (Thai Meteorological Department); from mid-January it usually settles, but a windy day can still delay or cancel boats. Do not plan a boat on the same morning as an important flight.

facts.title: Park and island fees 2026/27
facts.text: Per foreign adult (children about half): Phi Phi and Maya Bay 400 THB, plus 20 THB at Tonsai pier; Phang Nga Bay 300; Hong islands (Krabi) 300; Similan and Surin 500; Koh Rok and Koh Haa (Lanta) 400; Koh Lipe (Tarutao) 200; Ang Thong (Samui) 300. Pay in cash unless your tour includes it, so ask; Similan also sells e-tickets. Divers pay 200 more per diving day. Racha, Coral Island and Koh Yao have no park fee.

facts.title: Luggage on boats
facts.text: Most boats take one suitcase and one hand bag per person. Andaman Wave Master allows a suitcase up to 25 inches on its ferries and 18 inches on speedboats, and charges 300 THB for each extra bag; Lomprayah's limit is 20 kg. On speedboats bags sit in a pile at the back and can get wet, so use a dry bag. Phi Phi and Koh Lipe have no cars: porters (about 100 THB on Phi Phi) or longtails carry bags.

facts.title: Route: Phuket - Phi Phi - Krabi
facts.text: 08:30 ferry from Rassada to Phi Phi (2 h) or a speedboat (1 h). Stay 1-2 nights. Then the 14:30 ferry to Ao Nang or Railay (about 2 h), or 10:30, 13:30 or 15:30 to Krabi Town (2 h). Back to Phuket by speedboat from Ao Nang or Railay in 1-2 hours, to Rassada, Bang Rong or Laem Hin. About 450-1,100 THB per leg.

facts.title: Route: Phuket - Koh Lanta (and Phi Phi)
facts.text: Fast: speedboat Rassada - Saladan in about 1 h 30 (08:30-14:30, 1,260-1,700 THB). Slow and scenic: the 08:30 ferry to Phi Phi, change boats, at Lanta about 12:30 (about 4 h, 820-1,350 THB, November to April). Lanta - Phi Phi is 30 min to 1 h 30. Speedboats back to Phuket leave Lanta until about 15:30.

links.label: Phuket to Koh Lanta (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

facts.title: Route: Phuket - Koh Yao Noi - Koh Yao Yai
facts.text: Bang Rong to Manoh pier on Koh Yao Noi: 30-40 min by speedboat (about 400 THB), 08:40-17:00; the last boat back is about 16:00. Longtails cross from Manoh to Chong Lard on Koh Yao Yai in 10 min. Some Phuket - Ao Nang speedboats stop at Koh Yao, so you can go on to Krabi in about 1 hour.

facts.title: Route: Phuket - Koh Lipe
facts.text: In season the Satun Pakbara and Bundhaya speedboats leave Rassada at 08:30 and reach Koh Lipe about 13:30 (2,450-2,500 THB), via Phi Phi, Lanta and the Trang islands. Back about 09:00-10:30, in Phuket 14:30-16:00. Add the 200 THB park fee and about 50 THB for the longtail to the beach. Plan at least 3 nights.

facts.title: Route: Khao Lak - Similan
facts.text: From Phuket the van leaves about 05:30-07:00 and takes 1.5-2 hours to Thap Lamu pier. Check-in about 08:00, then 1 h 15 - 1 h 30 by speedboat. Back at the pier 16:30-17:30 and in Phuket in the evening. A night in Khao Lak cuts 3-4 hours of driving.

links.label: Thap Lamu Pier (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

facts.title: Last boats of the day
facts.text: There are no night boats between Phuket and the islands. Last boats back: Phi Phi ferry 15:30, speedboat about 17:00; Koh Yao Noi about 16:00; Lanta speedboats about 15:30; Ao Nang and Railay speedboats about 14:00, the Ao Nang Princess ferry 15:00-15:15. Samui to Koh Phangan: Lomprayah 17:30 from Bangrak, Haad Rin Queen speedboat 18:30.

ports-ferries.notes:
Adversarial fact-check of the ports-ferries result, done 19 Oct 2026. All 26 piers, 16 facts and 10 corrections are returned. Nothing was dropped: every pier, operator and route is real. I fixed about 45 details.

How it was checked:
- Live booking systems, queried for real January 2027 dates:
  - Seatran Discovery's engine on 12, 19, 22 and 23 Jan 2027. It also resells Andaman Wave Master, Phi Phi Cruiser, the Krabi - Phi Phi ferries, Lomprayah, Samui Tour, Phantip and the Haad Rin Queen.
  - Haad Rin Queen's own schedule API.
- Operator timetables: Andaman Wave Master (ferry, speedboat and baggage rules), Raja Ferry (Thai schedule and fare tables), Satun Pakbara (spcthailand.com and ferrylipe.com), Bundhaya (route seasons and prices), Ao Nang Travel and Tour (via ticket2attraction, 19 Oct 2026), Tigerline's timetable page, and the official Lomprayah 2026 PDF (text pulled out with pypdf).
- Coordinates: every pin was re-checked against the OSM API (nodes and ways, with centres and lengths). Drive times come from OSRM. Every pier pin was also run against the guide's own area polygons and boxes from check.mjs.
- Photos: every image URL loads, and licences come from the Commons API.

Main problems found:
- Wrong luggage rules: '18 kg' and '100 THB extra bags'.
- Laem Hin Koh Yao times that were really Bang Rong's.
- A wrong Andaman Wave Master Krabi time.
- A 'ferry' that is a speedboat (Klong Jilad - Lanta).
- Haad Rin Queen 'not sold online' (Seatran sells it).
- Wrong hotel-pickup surcharges.
- 700 m between the Bangrak piers (it is 900 m by road).
- Unsourced details: free toilets, 10 THB toilets, parking, a free van, and a 'one roof' terminal.
- Royal Phuket Marina sat 3.7 km outside its stated area. RPM and Laem Hin are now area 'koh-kaew': check.mjs has a box for it, build.mjs labels it 'Koh Kaew' and the merge script's OFF list accepts it.

Open items for the late-December re-check:
1. Tigerline has not published its 2026-27 timetable, so its Lanta times are the 2025-26 pattern.
2. The Ao Nang Princess daily high-season sailings (13:30 from Rassada, 10:30 from Ao Nang, from 15 Nov) come only from Visit Thailand Today.
3. Echo Travel's own site is offline, though it is listed on 12Go and Ferryscanner (Sep 2026).
4. Lomprayah's 2027 timetable is not out. Seatran's resale for 23 Jan 2027 matches the 2026 PDF times.
5. Overpass was down, so the toilets at Rassada (from the first researcher's OSM claim) could not be re-checked. I left 'toilets' and removed 'free'.

Photos:
- Added a March 2025 Commons photo of the Koh Lipe floating platform and a Bang Rong harbour photo.
- Dropped a 2003 Haad Rin photo that shows another ferry.
- Still no photos for Rassada, Laem Hin, Thap Lamu, Railay East, Manoh, Chong Lard, Saladan, Pralarn and Seatran Bangrak. Commons geosearch found nothing usable.

Not added:
- Boat Lagoon: it is covered by the Royal Phuket Marina item.
- Chean Vanich pier: it is in a Rassada tip, and Tigerline's 2027 service is not confirmed.

Island hopping Info: every other claim checks out against 2026 sources, including Samui's January rain (WMO 1991-2020: 126.8 mm on 8.5 days) and Maya Bay's 400 THB fee and closure dates.

islands.notes: Adversarial check of the 'islands' list, 19 Oct 2026. Result: 18 places (5 updated copies of existing day trips: phi-phi-maya-bay, similan-islands, phang-nga-bay-james-bond, koh-hong-krabi, railay-krabi; 13 new day-trip islands: koh-lanta, bamboo-island, koh-yao-yai, koh-panyee, surin-islands, koh-lipe, trang-islands, koh-racha-noi, koh-samui, koh-tao-nang-yuan, ang-thong-marine-park, koh-phi-phi-don-night, krabi-4-islands), 13 facts for an Info section 'Islands around Phuket', 2 corrections, no events, nothing removed. Every new island was confirmed as real and open in Jan 2027. How I checked: every timetable was re-read on phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026), Ferryscanner and Visit Thailand Today. Fees and seasons were checked against Thai Holiday Guide (Jun-Jul 2026), thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026), Siam Tour and Realty (Aug and 15 Oct 2026), Simba Sea Trips, Tisland and Naewna (14 Oct 2026). Coordinates were re-derived from the OSM API and Nominatim, with distances computed. All 28 image URLs were fetched, and their licences and authors confirmed with the Commons API. Drive times came from OSRM and FOSSGIS. Main fixes: (1) The e-ticket claims were too strong. The DNP launched e-tickets at six marine parks from 15 Oct 2025, but Siam Tour and Realty (15 Oct 2026) and Simba say most piers still take cash. So the fee texts were softened, the Info correction about Maya Bay cash was dropped, and the e-ticket fact is no longer critical. (2) The Koh Racha Noi pin was inland and 640 m from the OSM node it claimed to match. It now sits on the OSM Banana Bay node, and Banana Bay is on the sheltered east side, not in the north. (3) Krabi 4 Islands: 'too far from Phuket for a day' was wrong. A 9.5 h Phuket day tour is sold (Trip Store Krabi on TUI and Musement). (4) Koh Panyee 'no entry fee' was wrong: the island is inside Ao Phang Nga National Park. (5) Railay's 1,000-1,160 THB was a crossed-out list price. (6) Phang Nga Bay fee: 300 THB in 3 of 4 sources. (7) Koh Nang Yuan is about 250 THB (2026). (8) The Feb 2026 Samui weather claim was overstated. (9) The Ang Thong 'leave before 08:00' advice does not fit Phangan tours, which leave at 09:20. (10) The Thong Sala Directions point moved from the Songserm pier to the main Lomprayah and Seatran pier, 330 m away. (11) Bang Rong is about 17 km and 20-30 min from the airport, not 40 min; this is also a correction to koh-yao-noi. Conflicts left visible: thainationalparks.com lists Phi Phi at 200 THB but four 2026 sources say 400, so 400 is kept. For Mu Ko Lanta, the land HQ costs 200 THB, while Koh Rok tours charge 400 (a 2023 Thai article also says 400). Merge notes: the updated copies carry full tips lists, because PLACE_TAKE replaces tips. Koh Racha Noi's pin is in the bay, which is fine because check.mjs skips day-trip coordinates. Possible duplicates for the critic: krabi-4-islands against any 4 Islands tour in the island-tours list; koh-phi-phi-don-night (pin on Tonsai Pier) and the Thong Sala direction point against pier items in the ports list. Existing items not returned: hong-by-starlight was re-checked on the official page (3,950 THB, unchanged). koh-yao-noi has no change except the distance correction; phuketferry also lists Koh Yao Sun Smile boats to Laem Sai Pier, and the Manoh times match Ferryscanner and Camphadee. koh-racha-yai, coral-island-koh-hey and khai-islands were only checked through the tour prices used in the facts. No dated island events for 8-25 Jan 2027 outside Koh Phangan were found; the event lists cover those.
