places.name: Phi Phi Islands and Maya Bay
places.gmapsQuery: Maya Bay, Ko Phi Phi Le, Krabi
places.description: The famous islands 45-60 min by speedboat from Phuket. Tours visit Maya Bay (from the film The Beach), Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, snorkel spots and often Bamboo Island. At Maya Bay boats stop at a pier in Loh Samah Bay and you walk in. Swimming is banned there: knee-deep wading only.
places.feeText: Group speedboat tour about 1,500-3,500 THB; sunrise tours 3,500-4,500 THB. Park fee 400 THB (child 200). The park has sold e-tickets since Oct 2025, but cash is still taken at most piers. Some tours add the fee on top, so ask. Private speedboat 15,000-25,000 THB per boat.
places.gettingThere: Hotel pickup 6:30-7:30 to Rassada Pier (Phuket Town) or Royal Phuket Marina. Back about 16:00-17:00. Public boats Rassada - Tonsai leave 08:30-15:30: ferry about 2 h, 450-700 THB; speedboat about 1 h, 750-900 THB.
tips: Maya Bay takes up to 375 people per hour. Expect 30-60 minutes on the beach.
Sunscreen with oxybenzone, octinoxate, 4MBC or butylparaben is banned in Thai national parks (fines up to 100,000 THB).
No alcohol or smoking in the park. In April 2025 a boat driver was fined 10,000 THB after his guests drank and smoked at Pileh Lagoon.
Tours may ask for your passport number for the park ticket. Carry a copy of your passport.
For seasickness, take a pill 30 minutes before and sit at the back of the boat.
Staying a night on Phi Phi Don? Speedboats back to Phuket leave Tonsai until about 17:00. The last big ferries go at about 14:30-15:30.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Boats: phuketferry.com timetables (19 Oct 2026): Rassada to Tonsai 08:30-15:30, ferries 450-600 THB (PP Cabana 755), speedboats 800-900; Tonsai to Rassada until 17:00 (Bundhaya speedboat), last ferries 14:30-15:30. Visit Thailand Today (6 Oct 2026): ferries 500-700, speedboats 750-850, speedboats back until about 17:00. Phuket 101 (12 Apr 2026): tour, sunrise and private-boat prices, 400/200 fee, last ferry about 15:30. Tisland (28 Sep 2026): Maya Bay 375 per hour, wading only, Loh Samah pontoon, sunscreen ban. E-tickets since 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025; Tisland, Sep 2026), but Siam Tour and Realty (Oct 2026) says the rollout is phased and most piers still take cash, so the fee and passport texts were softened. Pileh fine: The Phuket News (incident 26 Apr 2025). Coords unchanged.

places.name: Similan Islands
places.gmapsQuery: Donald Duck Bay, Similan Islands, Phang Nga
places.description: A national park of granite islands about 60 km off the Khao Lak coast, with the clearest water and best snorkelling near Phuket. You climb Sail Rock on Island 8 for the famous view of Donald Duck Bay, snorkel between islands and have lunch on Island 4. Open 15 Oct 2026 to 15 May 2027.
places.feeText: Day tour from Phuket about 2,500-3,800 THB by speedboat, 3,600-5,650 THB by catamaran, with transfer, lunch and park fee. Park fee alone: 500 THB (child 250), as an e-ticket bought ahead or before 08:00 on the day; tours buy it for you. 2-day snorkel trips that sleep on a boat from about 9,400 THB.
places.openText: Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027. Day visits only: sleeping on the islands is banned. A liveaboard boat is the only legal way to stay overnight.
tips: Only 3,325 day visitors (plus 525 divers) are allowed per day, shared by all tour companies. Book ahead.
Avoid the cheapest speedboats: they are crowded. Mid-range boats have shade and space.
Entry is registered by name. Send your passport details when you book and carry a copy.
Do not feed fish, touch coral or take shells. Rangers give fines.
No alcohol on the islands, and no card payments. Bring cash.
Koh Tachai (Island 11) has been closed to landings since 2016, with no reopening date. Tours cannot take you onto its beach.
The ride is much shorter if you stay in Khao Lak.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027: Naewna (Thai news, 14 Oct 2026), Tisland (21 Sep 2026), Siam Tour and Realty (15 Oct 2026: parks open). Tisland: quota 3,850 = 3,325 + 525 divers, 500/250 THB, e-ticket via QueQ or e-ticket.dnp.go.th before 08:00, entry registered by name, no sleeping on the islands, no card payments, snorkel liveaboard from 9,400 THB. Tisland tour list (Oct 2026): speedboat tours 2,500-3,800 THB, catamaran 3,600-5,650, fee included. Koh Tachai closed indefinitely, no date announced (Siam Tour and Realty, 15 Oct 2026). Alcohol ban: National Park Act 2019 (The Phuket News, Apr-May 2025). Coords unchanged.

places.name: Phang Nga Bay: James Bond Island and sea caves
places.gmapsQuery: James Bond Island, Phang Nga
places.description: A calm bay full of tall limestone islands. Tours stop at James Bond Island (Khao Phing Kan and the Ko Tapu rock), take you by canoe into sea caves and hidden lagoons at Panak or Hong island, and stop for lunch at Koh Panyee, a Muslim fishing village on stilts.
places.feeText: Group tour 1,400-3,500 THB per person: longtail 1,400-1,600, big boat 1,500-1,800, speedboat 1,800-2,500, catamaran or premium 2,500-3,500. Park fee 300 THB (child 150) in most 2026 sources; Phuket 101 says 400. It is usually included in the tour.
tips: You cannot swim at James Bond Island, and boats cannot land on the Ko Tapu rock. Tours stop to swim at other islands.
In the caves a guide paddles the canoe for you. Check that canoeing is included.
At Koh Panyee, walk past the main souvenir walkway to see real village life. See its card.
Speedboats spend less time on the water and more time at the islands.
The Hong by Starlight trip also passes James Bond Island (seen from the boat only), so you may not need both.
No alcohol or smoking inside the national park. Boat crews can be fined for their guests.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Park fee 300 THB: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026), Siam Tour and Realty (Aug 2026, 300/150) and Simba Sea Trips (2026, 300/150); Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026) alone says 400/200, so 300 now leads. No landing on Ko Tapu: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026). Tour prices, piers and swim rule: Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026). E-tickets planned for this park from 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025), but cash is still common at piers (Siam Tour and Realty, Oct 2026). Alcohol rule: National Park Act 2019 (The Phuket News, Apr 2025). Coords unchanged.

places.name: Koh Hong (Krabi): lagoon island
places.gmapsQuery: Hong Island, Krabi
places.description: A limestone island between Koh Yao Noi and Krabi. Boats go into a shallow lagoon ringed by tall cliffs, and there are two white-sand beaches with clear water. Steep stairs lead to a viewpoint. It is part of a national park and is busy from late morning.
places.feeText: Park fee 300 THB per adult (child 150). Most tours collect it in cash at the entry point; the park has also sold e-tickets since Oct 2025. From Koh Yao Noi: longtail about 800 THB per person (2024). From Krabi or Ao Nang: group speedboat tours about 1,350-1,500 THB.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Fee 300/150 THB: Simba Sea Trips (2026), Siam Tour and Realty (Aug 2026) and 2026 Krabi tour listings, which say it is paid at the point of entry and not included. E-tickets at Than Bok Khorani park from 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025; Tisland, Sep 2026), but a phased rollout with cash still common (Siam Tour and Realty, Oct 2026), so the cash note was kept. Phuket 101 Koh Hong page (May 2024): longtail from Klong Jark about 20 min and 800 THB, no alcohol or drones. Krabi tours 1,350-1,500 THB (Baolau, AAA). Coords: OSM islet relation 5805205 centre 95 m from the pin.

places.name: Railay Beach (Krabi)
places.gmapsQuery: Railay Beach West, Krabi
places.description: A beach area in Krabi with no roads, closed in by huge limestone cliffs, so you arrive by boat. West Railay is a beautiful sunset beach and Phra Nang Cave Beach is close by. Famous for rock climbing. A direct ferry from Phuket makes a long day trip possible, but one or two nights is better.
places.feeText: Speedboat Phuket - Railay about 500-1,300 THB one way online, depending on the boat and the seller (phuketferry.com and Ferryscanner, Oct 2026).
places.openText: Boats to Railay leave Phuket about 08:30-15:00 from Rassada, Bang Rong or Laem Hin pier (1 h 20 min - 2 h 30 min). Back from Railay about 09:20-15:15.
places.gettingThere: Speedboat from Rassada Pier (Phuket Town), or from Bang Rong or Laem Hin pier on the east coast, to Railay East floating pier. Then a short walk to West Railay. Longtails link Railay with Ao Nang and Krabi Town.
tips: Book the ferry early: online prices rise close to the date.
Be at the pier 60 minutes before departure.
There are no night ferries back to Phuket.
The Krabi 4 Islands trip (Poda, Chicken, Tup) picks up in Railay and Ao Nang. See its card.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): to Railay East from Bang Rong 09:30 and 15:00, Rassada 11:00, 12:00 and 13:30, Laem Hin 13:00, 1 h 30 min - 2 h 30 min; back 09:20-13:40 to Laem Hin, Bang Rong or Rassada; current fares 500-900 THB (crossed-out 1,000-1,160, so the old 1,000-1,160 figure was the list price). Ferryscanner (9 Oct 2026): Rassada departures 08:30-13:30, EUR 17.65-36.08 (about 660-1,360 THB), Railay departures until 15:15. Coords unchanged.

places.name: Koh Lanta
places.coordSource: google maps 'Ban Sala Dan Pier (Koh Lanta)' + osm ferry_terminal node 260742654 'Sala Dan Pier' (7.64875, 99.04116), 58 m apart (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Saladan Pier in the north, where all boats from Phuket land
places.gmapsQuery: Ban Sala Dan Pier, Koh Lanta, Krabi
places.description: A long, relaxed island south-east of Phi Phi. The west coast has sunset beaches (Klong Dao, Long Beach, Klong Khong, Kantiang) and the east coast a wooden Old Town on stilts. Good for 3 or more quiet nights and snorkel trips to Koh Rok and the Trang islands. A few beach bars, but not a party island.
places.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket about 1,260-1,700 THB one way (1 h 30 min); slow ferry via Phi Phi 820-1,000 THB (about 4 h). National park at the south tip 200 THB. Scooter 200-300 THB a day.
places.openText: Boats leave Rassada Pier at 08:30, 11:00 and 12:30 (Oct 2026 timetable; check again in December). Back from Saladan Pier: ferry 08:00, speedboats 09:00-14:30.
places.bestTime: Stay at least 3 nights. November to April has calm sea for the Koh Rok trip. The west-coast beaches face the sunset.
places.gettingThere: Speedboat or ferry from Rassada Pier (Phuket Town) to Saladan Pier; the boats stop at Phi Phi. From Phi Phi it is 30 min by speedboat (about 700 THB). Grab barely works on Lanta: use tuk-tuks (Saladan to Kantiang 400-800 THB) or a scooter.
tips: Best day trip: the Koh Rok speedboat, about 1,800 THB plus a 400 THB park fee. Koh Rok is open in January.
The 4 Islands trip (Emerald Cave on Koh Mook, Kradan, Ngai, Chueak) costs about 1,000-2,000 THB plus a 200 THB park fee.
Nightlife is small: beach bars on Long Beach and Klong Khong, a fire show at 20:30 at Why Not Bar, and Pangea's Deep Sundays (see Events).
Lanta Old Town is good in the late afternoon, with a seafood dinner over the water.
The last speedboat back to Phuket leaves Saladan at about 14:30. Do not plan a flight on the same day.

links.label: Koh Lanta guide (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada speedboats 08:30, 11:00, 12:30 (Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya) 1,490-1,500 THB adult, 1 h 30 min; ferries 08:30 (Phi Phi Cruiser 820, Lanta Petpailin 1,000) 4 h; back: ferry 08:00, speedboats 09:00-14:30; Phi Phi - Lanta 30 min, 700 THB. Visit Thailand Today (15 Oct 2026): speedboat 1,260-1,700 THB, ferries via Phi Phi Nov-Apr, Koh Rok about 1,800 + 400 THB fee (Koh Rok closed Jun-Sep), 4 Islands longtail about 1,000 THB + 200 fee, Grab barely works, tuk-tuk 400-800, 3 nights minimum. Why Not Bar fire show 20:30: Visit Thailand Today nightlife page (2026). Park fee 200 THB at the south tip: thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026). Scooter 200-300 THB: Byklo (2026), 12Go. Coords: Google + OSM agree. The Koh Haa name was taken out of the Koh Rok tip: the sources price the Koh Rok trip only.

places.name: Bamboo Island (Koh Mai Phai)
places.nameThai: เกาะไม้ไผ่
places.coordSource: Commons geotags 'Bamboo Beach, Ko Mai Phai' and 'Long tail boats at Ko Mai Phai' (7.8183-7.8184, 98.7972) on osm beach way 270845225 'Bamboo Beach' (12 m from its edge, 88 m from its centre; re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = the boat landing on Bamboo Beach
places.gmapsQuery: Ko Mai Phai (Bamboo Island), Krabi
places.description: A small, flat island about 5 km north of Phi Phi Don, with white sand and shallow, clear water. There are no restaurants or hotels, only a ranger station. Snorkelling at the edges is fair. Most Phi Phi day tours stop here for 30-45 minutes, so midday is busy.
places.feeText: Phi Phi national park fee 400 THB per adult (child 200), the same ticket as Maya Bay. Usually part of a Phi Phi tour (1,500-3,500 THB). Private longtail or speedboat from Phi Phi Don about 1,500-2,500 THB per boat.
places.openText: Day visits only. Camping on the island is not allowed.
places.bestTime: Morning, about 09:00-10:00: few boats and clear water. Midday and early afternoon are busiest, with 15-20 speedboats.
places.gettingThere: Pick a Phi Phi speedboat tour from Phuket that lists Bamboo Island, or stay on Phi Phi Don and hire a boat at Tonsai for an early trip.
tips: There are no restaurants on the island. Bring water, a snack and something for shade.
No alcohol: the island is national park land.
Ask your tour at what time it stops here. A morning stop means more space and clearer water.
Do not stand on coral, and use reef-safe sunscreen.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 20 Mar 2026): about 5 km north of Phi Phi, ranger station only, no restaurants or hotels, 400/200 THB fee, private boat from Phi Phi Don 1,500-2,500 THB, 30-45 min tour stops, 15-20 speedboats at midday, quieter about 09:00-10:00. No camping on the outer islands: thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026; it lists 200 THB, but Phuket 101, Tisland and Siam Tour and Realty 2026 give 400). Coords: Commons geotags + OSM beach.

places.name: Koh Yao Yai
places.nameThai: เกาะยาวใหญ่
places.coordSource: osm ferry_terminal node 1029806558 'Chong Lard Pier' (8.08160, 98.58639) + google maps 'Chong Lard Pier', 15 m apart (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Chong Lard Pier, where most boats from Bang Rong land; the Laem Haad viewpoint (osm node 5495469124) is 1.3 km east; Klong Hia Pier is 2.5 km west
places.gmapsQuery: Chong Lard Pier, Koh Yao Yai, Phang Nga
places.description: The bigger, emptier sister of Koh Yao Noi, 30 min by speedboat from Phuket. Rubber farms, Muslim fishing villages and long quiet beaches: Laem Haad sandbar in the north, Loh Pared on the west coast for swimming and sunset. No bars or nightlife. Good for a calm scooter day or a resort night.
places.feeText: Speedboat Bang Rong - Koh Yao Yai 390-400 THB one way (30-40 min). Laem Haad sandbar is free. Scooter about 250-350 THB a day.
places.openText: Speedboats from Bang Rong Pier about 08:30-17:00. Back to Bang Rong about 06:30-16:00; the last one leaves Chong Lard Pier at 16:00 (Oct 2026).
places.bestTime: Go to Laem Haad at low tide, when the sandbar is out. Loh Pared is best for swimming and sunset. November to April is calm.
places.gettingThere: Grab or taxi to Bang Rong Pier (north-east Phuket). Speedboat 30-40 min to Chong Lard or Klong Hia Pier at the north end. Book a scooter or hotel pickup ahead: transport at the pier is not guaranteed.
tips: Check a tide table the night before. At high tide the Laem Haad sandbar is mostly under water.
Alcohol is not sold everywhere. Dress modestly in the villages.
There is little shade at Laem Haad. Bring water and sun cream.
Other boats: Rassada Pier at 09:00 (about 800 THB, hotel pickup) and Laem Hin Pier at 13:00 (about 400 THB).
From the island, longtails go to Koh Hong, Koh Panyee and James Bond Island.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Bang Rong to Chong Lard or Klong Hia 08:30-17:00, 390-400 THB, 30-40 min (Solomon, Koh Yao Sun Smile, Green Planet); back 06:30-16:00 (last: Solomon 16:00 from Chong Lard); Rassada 09:00 Bundhaya 800 THB with hotel pickup; Laem Hin 13:00 Green Planet 400 THB. The old tip read as if both cost 800; fixed. Phuket 101 (31 Jul 2026): Laem Haad free, Loh Pared on the west for swimming and sunset, no bars, alcohol not sold everywhere, arrange pickup, longtail trips to Koh Hong, Panyee and James Bond Island, motorbike from about 250 THB. Thai Holiday Guide (Sep 2026): sandbar only at low tide. Coords: OSM + Google agree.

places.name: Koh Panyee (stilt village)
places.nameThai: เกาะปันหยี
places.coordSource: Commons geotags 'Pier - panoramio (11)' and village photos (8.3359-8.3362, 98.5035); google maps 'Ko Panyi Darussalam Mosque' 95 m west; osm islet relation 5886070 'Ko Panyi' centre 72 m away (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Google's plain 'Ko Panyi' pin is 2.9 km off. Pin = the main pier
places.gmapsQuery: Ko Panyi Darussalam Mosque, Phang Nga
places.description: A Muslim fishing village built on stilts against a limestone rock in Phang Nga Bay, home to about 1,600 people. Walk past the souvenir lanes to the mosque, the school and the floating football pitch. Most James Bond Island tours stop here for lunch. No alcohol is sold.
places.feeText: The island is inside Ao Phang Nga National Park: park fee 300 THB (child 150), included in most tours. Phang Nga Bay tours from about 1,400 THB. On your own: longtail from Surakul Pier about 1,500 THB per boat, 20 min each way.
places.openText: Tour boats arrive about 11:00-13:00. When the tours leave in the afternoon, the village goes quiet.
places.bestTime: Before 10:00 or in the late afternoon, outside the tour lunch rush (11:00-13:00).
places.gettingThere: Most people come on a Phang Nga Bay tour from Phuket. On your own: drive about 90 min to Surakul Pier (Phang Nga) and hire a longtail there.
tips: Cover shoulders and knees, most of all near the mosque. No alcohol, pork or smoking in the village.
Ask before you photograph people, their homes or the school.
The floating football pitch is at the far end, past the souvenir area. Kids play there in the evening.
Simple rooms exist on the island if you want to see it after the tours leave.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 26 Mar 2026): stilt village (not floating), about 1,600 people in 360 families, mosque on the only solid ground, football pitch renovated in 2024, tours 11:00-13:00, before 10:00 is quiet, Surakul longtail about 1,500 THB and 20 min, about 90 min drive from Phuket, no alcohol, pork or smoking, simple bungalows (James Bond Hotel). Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): about 1,600 people, lunch stop crowded by mid-morning, park fee 300 THB. The old 'No entry fee' was changed: Tourscanner and a charter site say visitors pay the Ao Phang Nga park fee (300/150); no source says the village itself charges. The claim that the souvenir shops close had no source and was cut. Surakul Pier = osm node 2328228554. Coords: Commons geotags + Google mosque + OSM islet.

places.name: Surin Islands (Mu Ko Surin)
places.nameThai: หมู่เกาะสุรินทร์
places.coordSource: google maps 'Tourist Information National Park Kho Surin Ao Chong Kad' + osm way 660649792 'Chong Khad Coffee' (9.42239, 97.86950) at the park HQ, 9 m apart; osm beach 'Ao Chong Khad' 120 m north (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = park HQ at Ao Chong Khad on Koh Surin Nuea, where the boats land
places.gmapsQuery: Chong Khad Bay, Mu Ko Surin National Park
places.description: A remote marine park near the Myanmar border, known for clear water and shallow coral reefs. Day trips snorkel in several bays and visit a Moken (sea people) village on Koh Surin Tai. From Phuket it is a very long day (11-12 h), so many people go from Khao Lak or sleep a night in the park tents.
places.feeText: Park fee 500 THB (child 250), e-ticket. Day tour from Khao Lak about USD 100, from Phuket about USD 114. Park tent 300-450 THB a night, bungalow 3,000 THB. 2-day tent tour from Phuket from 6,500 THB (Tisland).
places.openText: Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027, daily 08:30-16:30. In January the park campsite is at Ao Mai Ngam (open 1 Dec - 15 May).
places.bestTime: December to April has the calmest sea. Boats leave the pier about 09:00 and are back about 17:00.
places.gettingThere: Tours include the van to Khura Buri Pier (pickup about 05:30 in Phuket, or about 1 h from Khao Lak), then a speedboat of about 1-1.5 h. There are no public ferries.
tips: No alcohol on the islands (fine 1,000 THB). Bring cash: there are no ATMs.
In the Moken village, wear a shirt over swimwear and ask before you take photos.
Book park tents by phone (076 472 145 or 076 472 146). The online booking was down in 2026.
The open sea can be rough. Take a seasickness pill before the 1-1.5 h boat ride.
Bring your passport or a copy for the park ticket.
Do not mix it up with Surin Beach in Phuket.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026): 500/250 THB, open 15 Oct - 15 May 08:30-16:30, campsites Ao Chong Khad 15 Oct - 30 Nov and Ao Mai Ngam 1 Dec - 15 May, tents 300-450 THB, bungalows 3,000 THB, online booking down, phone 076 472 145 / 146, Moken village on Ko Surin Tai, boats from Khura Buri Pier, no public ferries, day trips from Phuket not advised (pier 3.5-4 h by road). Tisland tour page (Oct 2026): 2D/1N tent from 6,500 THB, pickup 05:30, boat 09:00-10:20 and 15:30-17:00, park fee included, alcohol fine 1,000 THB. Siam Tour and Realty (15 Oct 2026): Surin open for 2026-27. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): Khao Lak day trip USD 100 (9-10 h), Phuket USD 114 (11-12 h), no ATM. Coords: Google + OSM.

places.name: Koh Lipe
places.nameThai: เกาะหลีเป๊ะ
places.coordSource: google maps 'Pattaya Beach' on Koh Lipe; osm beach way 91115478 'Pattaya Beach' 12 m away (108 m from its centre); osm ferry_terminal node 5425777804 (floating pier) 360 m south-east (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Pattaya Beach, where the boats from Phuket arrive
places.gmapsQuery: Pattaya Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun
places.description: A small island near the Malaysian border with white sand and very clear water, in the Tarutao national park area. Walking Street has cafes and bars, and Pattaya Beach has fire shows at night; Sunrise and Sunset beaches are quieter. It is 5 hours by speedboat from Phuket, so plan at least 3 nights.
places.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket 2,430-2,450 THB one way. Tarutao national park fee 200 THB in cash (valid 5 days). Longtail from the floating pier to the beach about 50 THB if not included.
places.openText: Speedboat from Rassada Pier at 08:30, arriving about 13:30 (stops at Phi Phi, Lanta and the Trang islands). Back from Lipe at 10:30, in Phuket about 16:00.
places.bestTime: November to April. The nearby park islands (Adang, Rawi) close from mid-May to mid-October.
places.gettingThere: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club or Bundhaya speedboat from Rassada Pier (about 5 h). From Koh Lanta: 10:30 boat, 3 h, about 1,700 THB. Boats stop at a floating pier off Pattaya Beach; a longtail takes you to the sand.
tips: With only a few free days, Koh Lanta (1.5 h) or the Trang islands (about 3 h) are much closer.
Fire shows on Pattaya Beach are the main night out. Bars line Pattaya Beach and Walking Street.
Longtail day trips go to Koh Adang (viewpoint), Koh Rawi and the pebble beach of Koh Hin Ngam.
Keep your park ticket: it is valid for 5 days on the other Tarutao islands.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada 08:30 to Pattaya Beach 13:30 (Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya), 2,430-2,450 THB adult, 6 stops; back 10:30 to Rassada 16:00; Lanta 10:30 to Lipe 13:30, 1,690-1,700 THB (route runs Oct-May only). GoAsia (17 Oct 2026): no deep-water pier, floating platform then longtail, park fee in cash. go-ferry and operator listings: longtail about 50 THB if not included. Thaizer (2026): park fee 200 THB valid 5 days, fire shows on Pattaya Beach, Nov-Apr. Coords: on the OSM Pattaya Beach way.

places.name: Trang islands: Koh Ngai, Koh Mook and Koh Kradan
places.nameThai: เกาะไหง เกาะมุก เกาะกระดาน
places.coordSource: osm hotel node 1700049055 'Thapwarin Resort' (7.42069, 99.20642) on Koh Ngai's east beach, 43 m away, + Commons geotag 'Ko nghai LT' (7.42035, 99.20676); osm island relation 12088738 centre 500 m south-west (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Koh Ngai's main east beach, the first stop of the boats from Phuket. Emerald Cave (Koh Mook) is at 7.3694, 99.2836
places.gmapsQuery: Ko Ngai, Trang
places.description: Three quiet islands south of Lanta. On Koh Mook you swim 80 m through the dark Emerald Cave to a hidden beach. Koh Kradan has a long white beach with coral close to shore, and Koh Ngai has calm water and resorts. No nightlife. Best with 2 or more nights.
places.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket 1,850-1,950 THB one way (2.5-3.5 h). From Koh Lanta 650-900 THB (40-50 min). Emerald Cave and Kradan (Hat Chao Mai park): park fee 200 THB. 4 Islands day tour from Lanta about 1,000-2,000 THB.
places.openText: Boats leave Rassada Pier at 08:30 and 12:30. The morning boat reaches Koh Ngai about 11:00, Koh Mook 11:20 and Kradan 11:35. Back: about 11:00-12:50, in Phuket 14:30-16:00.
places.bestTime: Enter the Emerald Cave before 09:00, before the tour groups; times move with the tide. Open October to May (the cave is closed 1 Jun - 30 Sep).
places.gettingThere: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club or Bundhaya speedboat from Rassada Pier; it is the same boat that continues to Koh Lipe. Longtails link the three islands. From the mainland, boats leave Pak Meng and Hat Yao piers in Trang.
tips: The cave tunnel is pitch dark in the middle and floods at high tide. Life jackets are used, and guides help weak swimmers.
Sleep on Koh Mook to swim into the Emerald Cave early, before the day boats from Lanta arrive.
Too far for a day trip from Phuket. From Koh Lanta, the 4 Islands tour covers all three in one day, with lunch on Kradan.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada 08:30 (Bundhaya, Satun Pakbara) to Koh Ngai 11:00-11:10 (1,850-1,900 THB adult) and 12:30 to 15:40; Koh Mook 08:30 to 11:20 and 12:30 to 15:50 (1,950); Kradan 11:35 (1,950); back from Koh Ngai 11:30 and 12:50, Koh Mook 11:00 and 12:30, in Rassada 14:30-16:00; Lanta to Koh Ngai 650 THB, to Koh Mook 900 THB. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): Emerald Cave 80 m pitch-dark swim, floods at high tide, closed 1 Jun - 30 Sep, Hat Chao Mai fee 200/100 THB, best before 09:00, life jackets and guides with ropes, mainland piers Pak Meng, Khuan Tung Ku and Hat Yao. Lanta 4 Islands about 1,000 THB (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026) to USD 57 (Expedia, 2026).

places.name: Koh Racha Noi
places.nameThai: เกาะราชาน้อย
places.coordSource: osm node 9412211176 'Banana Bay' (dive and snorkel mooring, 7.49839, 98.32507), in the bay about 200 m off the east coast of the osm island way 24936539 'Ko Raya Noi' (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). The old pin (7.50394, 98.32664) was inland, 640 m from this node, not 'the same point' as claimed. Pin = Banana Bay, where the snorkel boats moor; the island has no pier
places.gmapsQuery: Ko Racha Noi, Phuket
places.description: A wild island south of Racha Yai, 60-90 min by speedboat from Phuket. No village, hotel or restaurant: just rocky coves and very clear water, often over 20 m visibility. Snorkel boats stop in sheltered bays such as Banana Bay on the east side. Divers come for big boulders, leopard sharks and, with luck, manta rays.
places.feeText: Free entry. Snorkel day tour Racha Noi + Racha Yai from about 2,800 THB with breakfast, lunch and hotel transfer (Tisland). Dive shops in Chalong run dive day trips.
places.openText: Day trips only. Tour boats leave the pier about 09:00 and are back about 16:00-17:00.
places.bestTime: November to April, on a calm day. Manta rays pass from about January to March, but sightings are rare.
places.gettingThere: Hotel pickup about 07:00, then speedboat from Chalong Pier (60-90 min). Most tours have lunch on Racha Yai. The south coast has strong currents and swell: snorkellers stay in the sheltered bays.
tips: There is nothing to buy on the island. Tours serve lunch on Racha Yai.
Pick a calm day: Racha Noi gets more swell and current than Racha Yai.
Some tours add Koh Maiton to look for dolphins. Landing on Maiton is suspended (Phuket 101, Mar 2026).
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): no village, restaurant or shop, about 90 min from Chalong, visibility often 20-30 m, shallower northern bays calmer, exposed south coast with stronger current, mantas seasonal and not guaranteed, free entry, Nov-Apr. Dive-site pages (Aussie Divers, Phuket 101, Sea Bees): Banana Bay is the sheltered bay on the east side, halfway between the north and south tips, good for snorkelling. The old text put Banana Bay 'in the north'; fixed. Tisland tour page (Oct 2026): from 2,800 THB, pickup 07:00, boat 09:00, Racha Noi 10:00-11:00 with Banana Bay snorkel, lunch on Racha Yai, Maiton dolphin stop, at the pier 17:00. Phuket 101 (12 Mar 2026): Maiton access suspended. No free photo found on Commons or Wikidata.

places.name: Koh Samui
places.coordSource: google maps 'Chaweng Beach'; osm beach way 246391044 'Hat Chaweng' 54 m east of the pin, with beachfront hotels around it (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = central Chaweng Beach; Samui airport (osm) is about 1.9 km north
places.gmapsQuery: Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui
places.description: Thailand's second-biggest island, in the Gulf. You land here on the way to Koh Phangan. Chaweng is the busy beach and bar strip (Sound Club, see Events); Fisherman's Village in Bophut has a walking street on Monday, Wednesday and Friday evenings. Ang Thong park trips start here.
places.feeText: Flight Phuket - Samui about 4,700-4,900 THB one way (Oct 2026). Boat Samui - Koh Phangan 350 THB, or 500 THB with the van from the airport. Grab Bangrak - Chaweng about 250-350 THB.
places.openText: Fisherman's Village walking street: Mon, Wed and Fri about 17:00-23:00 (Friday is the biggest).
places.bestTime: On this trip Samui is a transfer point. Allow about 2.5 hours between a boat to Bangrak pier and your flight.
places.gettingThere: Bangkok Airways flies Phuket - Samui in about 1 hour. Bangrak (Big Buddha) pier, for boats to Koh Phangan, is about 10 minutes from the airport; Chaweng is about 15 minutes from Bangrak.
tips: Grab works on Samui, but not on Koh Phangan.
Fisherman's Village is close to Bangrak and the airport: a good dinner stop. Bring cash for the stalls.
Ang Thong Marine Park tours leave from Nathon or Bophut. See its card.

links.label: Koh Phangan to Koh Samui guide (Sep 2026)

places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (28 Sep 2026): Bangrak about 10 min from the airport and 15 min from Chaweng, Grab Bangrak - Chaweng 250-350 THB, boats 350 THB, allow 2.5 h between the boat and a flight. Thai Holiday Guide (Jun 2026): walking street Mon, Wed, Fri 17:00-23:00, Friday biggest, cash for stalls (older Hotels.com pages say Friday only; Friday is safe either way). Flight fares and Grab on Samui: this guide's Info and Apps pages (Google Flights 16 Oct 2026; Grab city list). Samui is Thailand's second-largest island after Phuket. Coords: next to the OSM Chaweng beach way.

places.name: Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan
places.nameThai: เกาะเต่า เกาะนางยวน
places.coordSource: google maps 'Mae Haad Pier' + osm bus_stop node 4078079887 'meeting point' at the pier head (10 m) and the osm pier ways 13-50 m west (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Mae Haad Pier, where boats from Koh Phangan land; Koh Nang Yuan is about 4 km north
places.gmapsQuery: Mae Haad Pier, Koh Tao
places.description: A small, rocky diving island 1 hour north of Koh Phangan. Koh Nang Yuan, off its north-west coast, is three islets joined by sandbars, with a famous viewpoint and good snorkelling. Sairee Beach has the bars and beach parties at night. An easy day trip from Koh Phangan.
places.feeText: Boat Thong Sala - Koh Tao 450-600 THB one way. Koh Nang Yuan (a private island) entry about 250 THB in cash (2026; one guide still says 100). Longtail Koh Tao - Nang Yuan about 100-200 THB per person each way.
places.openText: Fast boats leave Thong Sala 08:30-16:45; the 08:30 Lomprayah also stops at Nang Yuan. Back to Koh Phangan for a day trip: Lomprayah 15:30 catamaran or 16:30 ferry.
places.bestTime: Reach Nang Yuan before 11:00, when the day-trip speedboats arrive. Climb the viewpoint first, before the queue.
places.gettingThere: Lomprayah, Boonsiri or Songserm from Thong Sala Pier (about 1 h) to Mae Haad Pier. Longtails to Nang Yuan wait at Mae Haad and Sairee Beach (10-15 min). A speedboat snorkel tour from Koh Phangan is the easy option.
tips: Single-use plastic, such as plastic bottles, is not allowed on Nang Yuan. Bring a refillable bottle.
The viewpoint climb takes 15-25 minutes with some rock scrambling. Wear shoes, not flip-flops.
Agree the price and the return time with the longtail driver before you go.
Good for the two of you on Wed 20 or Thu 21 Jan, between the night parties. Check the wind: speedboats can stop on windy days.

links.label: Koh Phangan to Koh Tao boats (Oct 2026)

places.description: A national park of limestone islands north-west of Koh Samui. Day tours kayak and snorkel, climb a steep trail to a viewpoint over the islands, and walk up to Emerald Lake, a green salt lake inside an island (no swimming). It closes every year about 1 Nov - 15 Dec, so it is open in January.
places.feeText: Park fee 300 THB (child 150), paid separately in cash. Speedboat day tour from Koh Phangan about 1,900 THB (Click2Go) or from USD 72; bigger boats leave from Samui.
places.openText: Daily 08:00-17:00. Closed about 1 Nov - 15 Dec each year for the monsoon and reef recovery.
places.bestTime: December to April. From Koh Phangan the Click2Go speedboat leaves at 09:20 and is back about 15:45. From Samui, an early speedboat beats the big boats, which arrive about 10:00.
places.gettingThere: Only with a licensed tour boat. From Koh Phangan, speedboat tours pick you up at your hotel (07:30-08:30) or meet at the pier. From Samui, tours leave Nathon or Bophut.
tips: The viewpoint trail is about 500 m but steep, with ropes: 25-45 minutes each way. Wear closed shoes and bring water.
Emerald Lake is about 240-300 steps up. Swimming in the lake is not allowed.
From Thong Nai Pan or Than Sadet, pickup costs 300 THB extra. Bottle Beach (Haad Khuad), Haad Khom and Haad Yuan have no pickup.
No alcohol in the park. Bring cash for the fee: card machines are not reliable.
Strong wind can cancel the trip for a day. Do not plan it for your last day before a flight.

facts.title: Which island for what
facts.text: Party: Koh Phangan (raves) and a night on Phi Phi Don (beach bars). Snorkelling: Similan, Surin, Racha Yai and Noi, Koh Rok. Quiet beaches: Koh Yao Noi and Yao Yai, Koh Ngai, Koh Kradan. Views: Phang Nga Bay, Koh Hong, Railay, Ang Thong. Village life: Koh Panyee. Short and easy: Coral Island, the Khai Islands, or Koh Bon (10-15 min by longtail from Rawai, about 1,200 THB per boat, return).

facts.title: Day trip or overnight
facts.text: Fine as a day trip from Phuket: Phi Phi and Maya Bay, Phang Nga Bay, Similan (very early start), Racha Yai and Noi, Coral Island, Khai, Koh Yao Noi and Yao Yai. Better with nights: Phi Phi Don and Railay (1-2), Koh Yao Noi (2-3), the Trang islands (2 or more). Plan 3 nights or more: Koh Lanta and Koh Lipe (5 h each way). Surin: an 11-12 h day from Phuket, or a night in the park tents.

facts.title: National park fees (2026 rates)
facts.text: Per foreign adult: Similan and Surin 500 THB; Phi Phi, Maya Bay and Bamboo Island 400; Phang Nga Bay and Koh Panyee 300 (one guide says 400); Koh Hong (Krabi) 300; Ang Thong 300; Koh Lanta park, Koh Mook (Emerald Cave), Koh Kradan, Koh Lipe and the Krabi 4 Islands 200 (Koh Rok tours charge 400). Children pay about half. Also in cash: Phi Phi Don pier 20 THB and Koh Nang Yuan about 250 THB.

links.label: Park fees 2026 (Siam Tour and Realty, Aug 2026)

facts.title: E-tickets for six marine parks
facts.text: Since 15 Oct 2025, the Phi Phi, Phang Nga Bay, Koh Hong (Than Bok Khorani), Similan, Surin and Koh Lanta parks sell e-tickets with a QR code, bought ahead (QueQ app or e-ticket.dnp.go.th) or before 08:00 on the day. The rollout is slow, and most piers still take cash (Oct 2026). Tours handle it: send your passport details when you book and carry a copy.

facts.title: Seasons and closures
facts.text: Open in January: Similan and Surin (15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027), Maya Bay (closed only 1 Aug - 30 Sep), Koh Rok, the Emerald Cave and Ang Thong (closed about 1 Nov - 15 Dec). Sleeping on the Similan islands is banned: only liveaboard boats stay overnight. Koh Tachai (Similan) has been closed to landings since 2016. Landing on Koh Maiton is suspended (Phuket 101, Mar 2026).

facts.title: Park rules: alcohol, drones, sunscreen
facts.text: No alcohol in national parks: rules under the 2019 National Park Act ban drinking and selling it there. In April 2025 a boat driver was fined 10,000 THB after his guests drank and smoked at Pileh Lagoon, and Sirinat park (Nai Yang, Mai Khao) warns of fines from 5,000 THB. Drones need written park permission; Koh Hong bans them. Do not feed fish or touch coral. Banned sunscreens: fines up to 100,000 THB.

links.label: News: alcohol ban in Sirinat park (May 2025)

facts.title: Beat the crowds
facts.text: Most tour boats reach Maya Bay, James Bond Island, Bamboo Island and Koh Panyee between 10:00 and 14:00. Book an early or sunrise departure, or sleep on the island and go at 07:00-09:00. Emerald Cave: before 09:00. Koh Nang Yuan: before 11:00.

facts.title: A private boat for the group
facts.text: For 8 people a private speedboat can cost about the same per person as a good group tour: Phi Phi about 15,000-25,000 THB per boat (about 1,900-3,100 THB each), Khai Islands 2,500-5,000 THB per boat. You choose the start time, so you can be first at Maya Bay. Ask what is included: fuel, lunch, snorkel gear and park fees.

links.label: Phi Phi tours and private boats (Phuket 101)

facts.title: Island hopping on one boat
facts.text: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club and Bundhaya speedboats leave Rassada Pier at 08:30 and stop at Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Ngai, Koh Mook and Koh Kradan on the way to Koh Lipe (13:30). A second boat at 12:30 goes to Lanta, Koh Ngai and Koh Mook. Phi Phi - Lanta is 30 min (about 700 THB). Times are from Oct 2026: check again in December.

facts.title: Group days 8-18 Jan: the island plan
facts.text: If the group stays in Phuket on 10-14 Jan, use these days for the long trips: Similan (pickup 03:00-07:30), Phi Phi and Maya Bay, Phang Nga Bay. Hong by Starlight is best on dark nights early in the trip (new moon 8 Jan). A night on Phi Phi Don fits Mon 11 or Tue 12. The day after Circoloco (Sun 10, Sun 17), choose a short trip with a late start: a longtail from Rawai to Coral Island or Koh Bon.

facts.title: The two of you, 19-23 Jan: Gulf islands
facts.text: From Koh Phangan: Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan (08:30 boat, back 15:30 or 16:30), or an Ang Thong speedboat tour (about 1,900 THB plus the 300 THB park fee). Both fit Wed 20 or Thu 21 between the night parties. Koh Ma, a free snorkel spot on a sandbar at Mae Haad beach (north-west Koh Phangan), is 25 min from Thong Sala; snorkel at high tide. Keep Fri 22 easy and Sat 23 for the boat and the flight.

links.label: Koh Phangan to Koh Tao boats (Oct 2026)
Koh Ma sandbar (Thai Holiday Guide, Jul 2026)

facts.title: Solo days 24-26 Jan: islands near the airport
facts.text: From Nai Yang, take a Grab to Bang Rong Pier (about 17 km, 20-30 min) for boats to Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai (30-40 min, about 400 THB). Join-in tours cost the same alone: Khai Islands half day about 1,100 THB, Racha Yai from 1,300 THB. Sun 24 and Mon 25 work well. Do not book a boat trip on Tue 26: boats can be late, and you must be at the airport by 15:20.

facts.title: Speedboats and the weather
facts.text: In January the Andaman Sea on the Phuket side is usually calm. The Gulf (Samui, Phangan, Tao) can be windier: on 19 Feb 2026 a cold spell brought 1-2 m waves and red flags to Samui, ferries warned of delays and speedboats to Koh Tao were told to take care. Speedboats bounce, so sit at the back and take a seasickness pill 30 minutes before. Never plan a boat on the same day as a flight home.

island-events-gulf.notes:
Fact-check run on 19 Oct 2026. Sources re-queried: Vibez buyer API (Lost Jungle), Megatix API (all 451 live listings via /api/v2/events/search plus single-event data for Seaside, Daft Funk, Hollystone, JE, OXA, Halfmoon, Secret Party, Leo Beach, Retro Mountain), phangan.events WP REST (3,132 events edited since 1 Mar 2026) and its EventON calendar feed for Jan 2027 (with repeat series), Entrix event pages, Eventpop page data (Waterfall 25 Oct), RA GraphQL (Thailand area 67: no Gulf events in Jan 2027, only Phuket, Bangkok and Spirit Gust), Telegram t.me/s/phanganparty and t.me/s/epsamui, the Lomprayah quota API and the Seatran route API for Jan 2027, Photon/OSM, the organisers' Google short links and the Commons API. All 13 items survive, with fixes.

Main problems found: (1) Lost Jungle line-up was the old 'Phase 2'. The organiser's ticket page now shows the 'Final Phase' flyer (Audiofools and Capodanna out, 9 new names). (2) Entrix shows 'Age 21+' and 'Tropical / smart casual' on every event, even an ecstatic dance, so all '21+ on Entrix' claims (Seaside, Bluerama, Hii, Bambu, the ID fact) were unsupported. Megatix age fields are set by organisers and were used instead (JE, Hollystone, Halfmoon, Leo Beach 20+, Retro Mountain 21+, OXA 18+). (3) The 'Seatran' boats to Koh Tao (08:45, 13:15, 15:45) are Boonsiri boats sold on the Seatran site. (4) Bluerama '200 m above the sea' is not on its site; removed. (5) 'Hii Festival is run by the phangan.events team' is unsupported: Entrix shows 'Phangan Events' as organiser for parties it only resells (Seaside, Daft Funk). (6) Seaside kept a 23 Sep 2026 flyer as image; dropped. Zen Beach poster with 'every Thursday' dropped. (7) Merkaba Facebook link could not be verified; dropped. (8) The Bluerama and Merkaba weekly repeat series the researcher cited did not appear in the EventON feed for Oct-Nov or Jan, so January days stay patterns. (9) Waterfall online GA is 1,400 THB (early bird rounds 1,100-1,300), not 1,300. (10) Sat 23 Jan 07:30 Lomprayah Thong Sala-Bangrak showed only 2 pier seats (5 with airport van) left online.

Researcher's 'left out' reasons re-checked: Club SEEN Samui does have January dates: 'O BEACH IBIZA x CLUB SEEN Koh Samui SUNDAYS' on Megatix, every Sunday 27 Dec 2026-14 Feb 2027 (10, 17, 24 Jan), 12:00-23:00, 18+, early bird 800 sold out, general 900 THB plus fee, season pass 4,000 THB, venue CLUB SEEN, Sala Koy Road (OSM 'SEEN Beach Club Samui' 9.5215, 100.0586). Not added because it is a commercial Ibiza pool party; add it only if the guide wants Samui pool parties. Beat Boat has no live Entrix page (404). Out of window: Karacus Marakus XI, Nakhon Si Thammarat, 29 Jan-2 Feb 2027 (Ticketmelon). PsyCalendar lists Parvati Day & Night as Sat 16:00 to Mon 16:00; the organiser's own data (18:00 to 17:00) was kept.

Already fixed in the live guide by another pass (no correction needed): the Daft Funk Phuket tip and price now say Jungle Experience and 990 sold out. The phangan.events Jan 2027 calendar has only Eden Garden Saturdays, Chill Up Monday Madness and PsyDay, Lost Jungle, Daft Funk, the Full Moon Party, Club SEEN Sundays and a Wednesday market (Bizarre Bazaar at Seaboard) for the Gulf. Melodic house, techno and deep grooves, a fire show and an art market. In Jan 2026 it ran every Thursday. In Full Moon weeks it often becomes a 'pre-Full Moon' party 3-5 days before.
events.recurrence: High season 2026: every Thursday (8, 15, 22 and 29 Jan). Later in 2026 it was mostly on Thursdays, a few times on a Wednesday. In Full Moon weeks it often became a 'Pre-Full Moon' party 3-5 days before (Mon 27 Jul, Mon 24 Aug, Wed 23 Sep, Thu 22 Oct 2026), but there were none in Jan or Feb 2026. Jan 2027 guess: Thu 14 Jan, and Mon 18 or Tue 19 Jan.
events.timeText: 17:00 until about 05:00 (2026 listings)
events.priceText: Oct 2026 on Megatix: online 300 THB early bird, 400 presale, 500 regular. At the door free before 21:00 (women before 22:00), then 500 THB. VIP 1,000 THB.
tips: Not announced for Jan 2027 yet. Check phangan.events or the Phangan Party Guide on Telegram a week before.
In 2026 weeks with a Thursday or Friday Full Moon, phangan.events listed no Thursday party here, only the Monday pre-Full Moon edition. So do not count on Thu 21 Jan.
It is on Haad Rin Nai, the sunset beach, not on the Full Moon beach.
The dance floor is covered (Megatix, Oct 2026). Some weeks the party is on a Wednesday instead of Thursday.
lineup: Dava Di Toma (Solar Conexion / Seaside, resident)
events.verification: Re-checked 19 Oct 2026. Megatix API (promoter 'SEASIDE Koh Phangan'): 'Seaside Pre Full Moon Beach Party' Thu 22 Oct 2026 17:00-05:00, venue Seaside Sunset Bar, 70/1 Haad Rin Nai; online 300 early bird, 400 presale, 500 regular THB (fees included); at the door free for ladies before 22:00 and for men before 21:00, then 500 THB; VIP 1,000 THB, VIP table 8,000 THB for 4; fire shows, laser show, art market, covered dance floor; residents Sacred Beat, Dava Di Toma, Tino Moreno. The Entrix page shows '21+', but Entrix shows '21+' and 'Tropical / smart casual' on every event (also on an ecstatic dance), so it is not used as a venue rule. phangan.events 2026: weekly parties mostly on Thursdays (8 and 15 Oct), some on Wednesdays (22 Jul, 5 Aug, 30 Sep); pre-Full Moon editions Mon 27 Jul, Mon 24 Aug, Wed 23 Sep and Thu 22 Oct, 3-5 days before the Full Moon Parties of Fri 31 Jul, Fri 28 Aug, Sat 26 Sep and Tue 27 Oct. events.name: Retro Mountain Jungle Club
events.venue: Retro Mountain Jungle Club, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan

events.gmapsQuery: Retro Mountain Jungle Club Phangan, Ban Tai
events.description: Jungle club on a hill in Ban Tai, Koh Phangan, with two stages and a rain-proof main dance floor. Different crews run the nights: hard techno 'Secret Rave' by Hardtechno KPG, Kovër Crëw techno nights, psytrance, and guests like Nakadia. One of the best places on the islands for dark, hard techno.
events.recurrence: Usually 1-3 party nights a week; the program changes every week
events.priceText: Usually 350-800 THB in 2026 (RA). Many Aug-Oct 2026 nights were free before 22:00 (Techno Tropics, Jungle Clubbing, Halloween rave; online from about 200 THB). Big names cost more (Family Piknik, Feb 2026: 2,000 THB).
tips: In Jan 2026 there were 12 party nights here between 4 and 29 Jan, spread over the week. Jan 2027 dates are not out yet.
Sep-Oct 2026 nights: hard techno raves, Techno Tropics (Mon 12 Oct), Nakadia (Thu 1 Oct) and a Dreamland psytrance rave.
Arrive before 22:00: on many nights entry is free until then.
Megatix lists its Oct 2026 Halloween rave as 21+. Bring your passport or a photo ID.
Check phangan.events or the 'Phangan Party Guide' Telegram channel for the week's parties.
It is on a hill. Go by taxi, or by scooter only if you are a confident rider.
Koh Phangan is far from Phuket. The fastest way is a flight to Koh Samui, then a boat. Plan at least 2 nights.

Adults only (organiser listing). Bring ID, swimwear and a towel.
Your Saturdays are Circoloco nights in Phuket (9, 16 and 23 Jan). This fits only if you change plans.

facts.title: Party on Koh Tao? Stay the night
facts.text: Koh Tao is 1 to 1.5 hours by boat from Thong Sala. In Jan 2027 Lomprayah has 7 boats a day from 08:30 to 16:45 (450-600 THB). Boonsiri boats, sold on the Seatran site, leave at 08:45, 13:15 and 15:45 (600 THB). The last boat back leaves Koh Tao at 16:30. There are no night boats, so book a room on Koh Tao.

links.label: Seatran Discovery booking (Boonsiri boats to Koh Tao)

facts.title: Free rides go to the party, not back
facts.text: On Koh Tao some tickets include a free ride to the party, never back. Secret Party: 22:00-24:00 from the 7-Eleven by Factory Café and the Sairee petrol station. Leo Beach: 21:00-24:00 from Sairee and Mae Haad. Hii Festival: 21:30-02:00. For the way home, agree the taxi price before you get in.

facts.title: Buy online and arrive early
facts.text: Online tickets cost less than the door: Waterfall 1,100-1,400 THB vs 1,500, Jungle Experience 850-1,000 vs 1,200, Secret Party Koh Tao 500-700 vs 800. Many nights are free early: Lighthouse before 22:00, Seaside before 21:00 (women 22:00), Hollystone before 21:00, Bambu before 16:00, many Retro Mountain nights before 22:00. Jungle Experience, OXA and Halfmoon do not refund tickets.

facts.title: Where island parties sell tickets
facts.text: Megatix: OXA, Jungle Experience, Hollystone, Halfmoon, Groovy Tunes (Unclave), Secret Party and Leo Beach. Entrix (entrix.vip): Waterfall, Bambu, Bluerama and Hii Festival. Seaside and Retro Mountain sell on both. Eventpop: Waterfall and Halfmoon. Get In: Utopia. Vibez: Lost Jungle. Buy from the links in this guide or on the organiser's own page.

facts.title: Bring ID: many parties are 20+
facts.text: Age limits set by the organisers on Megatix: Jungle Experience, Hollystone, Halfmoon and Leo Beach 20+, Retro Mountain 21+ (Oct 2026), OXA 18+. Bluerama is adults only. Entrix shows '21+' on every event, so it does not tell you the real rule. Halfmoon checks that the name on the ticket matches your passport. Carry your passport or a photo ID.

facts.title: Island parties: sleep on the island
facts.text: No ferries go back to Phuket at night. From Phi Phi the last ferry leaves at about 15:30 and the last speedboat at about 17:00 (Oct 2026), but the party boats come back at about 19:00. A private speedboat after the party costs about 15,000 THB (Blanco, 2026). For a party night on Phi Phi, Koh Lanta or Railay, book a room there and come back the next day.

facts.title: Phi Phi at night
facts.text: The party strip is Loh Dalum Beach, a few minutes' walk from Tonsai Pier. Fire shows start at about 19:00-21:00 and the bars play loud music until about 02:00, Stones until 02:30. Stay out of the fire-show area, never try the fire rope, and do not swim after drinking. Rooms near Loh Dalum and Tonsai are noisy.

facts.title: Koh Lanta at night
facts.text: Lanta is calm, and each party night is at a different beach bar (local guide, 2026): Pangea on Long Beach on Tuesday and Sunday, The Ozone on Long Beach on Thursday, Fusion Beach Bar near Relax Bay on Friday. Why Not Bar in Kantiang Bay has fire shows every night. The bars are far apart and late tuk-tuks are rare, so ask your hotel to book a driver.

facts.title: Railay and Ao Nang at night
facts.text: Railay has no roads. Shared longtails to Ao Nang cost 100 THB per person and leave when about 8 people are waiting. After about 18:00 it is about 150 THB, and boats run until about 21:00-22:00. If nobody else is waiting, you pay 600-800 THB for the whole boat (Aug 2026). Railay nightlife is small reggae bars and fire shows, busiest on East Railay.

facts.title: Boat parties: what to bring
facts.text: Bring your passport or original ID (Sail Away is 20+, Blanco 18+), cash for the balance and the bar, reef-safe sunscreen and a dry bag. You cannot bring your own drinks. No drinking or smoking inside the national park at Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. If rough sea stops the trip, they move the date or refund you, but Blanco keeps your deposit if you cancel.

facts.title: Underground boat parties
facts.text: Underground crews run a boat party only now and then, posted a few weeks ahead. Example: SUB's UK garage and drum and bass boat party from Chalong Pier on Tue 27 Jan 2026, 12:00-19:00, 3,990 THB, only 40 tickets (Resident Advisor). Nothing is announced for Jan 2027 yet (19 Oct 2026). Check RA and @subphuket in December.

facts.title: Speedboat, big boat, catamaran or longtail
facts.text: Speedboats are the fastest (Phi Phi in about 1 hour) but bumpy, and carry 15 to 60 people. Big boats are slow and steady, cheaper and better if you get seasick; they often carry 40 to 80. Catamarans are stable with a big deck for sun and sunset, but slow. Longtails are for short hops near Ao Nang, Phi Phi Don or Phang Nga town.

facts.title: Small group, big group or private
facts.text: Budget tours put 30 to 60 people on one speedboat. Small-group boats (max 18-20, like Simba or Phuket Sail Tours) cost about 4,400-5,310 baht each. For 8 friends a private speedboat at about 20,000-46,600 baht per boat (2,500-5,800 each, often with pickup, lunch and park fees) costs about the same, and you choose the time and the stops.

facts.title: Fair prices in January
facts.text: Per person with pickup and lunch (operator prices, Oct 2026): Phi Phi by speedboat 1,900-3,500 baht, small group or sunrise 4,400-5,310. James Bond Island 1,500-2,900 (the cheapest add the park fee), small group 4,500. Racha + Coral 1,100-1,300. Khai half day 1,000-1,200. Similan from Khao Lak 3,900-4,100, plus 300-400 for a Phuket pickup. Much cheaper offers often add fees at the pier.

facts.title: National park fees
facts.text: Paid per person, in cash at the park or inside the tour price: Phi Phi and Maya Bay 400 baht (child 200), Phang Nga Bay 300 (150), Hong Islands in Krabi 300, Similan 500 (250, bought ahead with your passport details), Ang Thong 300. Krabi's 4 Islands: usually 200, but some signs still say 400. Racha and Coral Island: no fee. Pay only rangers and keep the ticket.

facts.title: What is included, and what costs extra
facts.text: Most tours include hotel pickup, lunch, water, mask, snorkel, life jacket and basic insurance. Often extra: fins (100-200 baht), the park fee, pickup from outer areas like Kamala, Cape Panwa or Nai Yang (100-400 baht per person, or a private car), the longtail into Pileh Lagoon, alcohol, photos and tips. Ask for the pier and pickup time in writing.

facts.title: Life jackets and reef rules
facts.text: Since 22 Apr 2025, snorkellers near coral must wear a life vest the whole time, unless they have a freediving card. One guide may watch up to 20 snorkellers. Touching coral or sea life and feeding fish are banned, and staff must stop your swim if you break the rules. In national parks use reef-safe sunscreen only.

links.label: TAT: new diving and snorkelling rules (May 2025)

facts.title: Safety on the water
facts.text: Accidents happen in high season too. On 11 Jan 2026 a tour speedboat from Chalong Pier with 55 people on board hit a fishing trawler between Koh Khai and Phi Phi, in 2 m waves: 1 tourist died and about 22 were hurt. The boat's driver was arrested and stricter checks were ordered. Choose a known operator with good recent reviews, and wear the life jacket when the sea is rough.

links.label: News: Phi Phi speedboat crash (Thai Examiner, Jan 2026)
News: the same crash (Baird Maritime, Jan 2026)

facts.title: Bad weather and refunds
facts.text: January is usually calm, but windy days can bring 2 m waves, and the Gulf around Koh Phangan is rougher. If the operator or the park cancels for weather, you get a new date or a full refund. If you cancel yourself, most tours refund only up to 24 hours before; Similan and Ang Thong trips need 48 hours, and Similan park fees are not refunded. Keep a spare day.

links.label: Similan tour rules (Khao Lak Land Discovery)

facts.title: Where to book
facts.text: Booking direct on the operator's website usually gives the clearest price, pier and pickup time. GetYourGuide and Viator add reviews, card payment and free cancellation up to 24 hours before on most tours; on Klook the rules differ by tour. Street agents sell the same budget boats: ask for the operator's name and the pier. In January book small-group boats and Similan trips early.

facts.title: Red flags
facts.text: No tourism licence number when you ask for it (check it in the government's Thailand Tourism Directory), a 'small group' that turns out to be 40-60 people, Phi Phi far below 1,500 baht, a park fee taken without a ticket, no life jackets, fake '50% off' prices, fish feeding offered as a stop, and jet-ski add-ons. Read reviews from the last few months, not only the average score.

links.label: How to check a tour licence (Railay Eco Tour, Jul 2026)

facts.title: Seasickness and what to bring
facts.text: Take a seasickness pill 30 minutes before the boat and sit at the back of a speedboat. The morning sea is calmer than the ride back. Phang Nga Bay is calm; Phi Phi, Similan and Ang Thong are open sea. Bring a dry bag for your phone, a towel, a hat, water shoes, cash and reef-safe sunscreen.

facts.title: Timing your boat days
facts.text: Maya Bay and James Bond Island are crowded about 10:00-14:00, so take a 06:00-07:00 start or a late tour. Do not book a 05:00 pickup for the morning after Circoloco (Sun 10 and Sun 17 Jan). For glowing plankton go early in the trip: new moon is Fri 8 Jan 2027, full moon Fri 22 Jan.

island-tours.notes:
Adversarial fact-check of the island-tours list, 19 Oct 2026. Every operator page was fetched again live with curl and read as page text (not AI summaries). Prices were read from the visible page, the schema data and the booking calendars. Pins were re-derived from Google Maps search results and OSM/Overpass, drive times from OSRM. All 30 image URLs return 200 with an image type, and the Commons credits and licences were confirmed through the Commons API. All 13 tours are kept (none removed); no new card was added. Simba's Locals Island private half day (15,950 THB for up to 25, 14:30 to sunset) went into the private-speedboat and sunset cards instead.

Main errors found: (1) Phuket Dive Tours' Khai half day says 'CURRENTLY NOT RUNNING', and its 800 THB is the child price (adult 1,500). (2) Love Andaman's normal 09:00 James Bond / Hong program is not sold now; only the 06:30 early program runs (Hong about 07:30, James Bond about 09:40). Its 'park fee included' claims were unsupported: the Maiton page includes park fees only for Thai guests. Pickup is +300 THB in its notes, although its meta text says 'included'. (3) Angthong Tours' big boat is 1,500 or 2,200 THB depending on the page, and its 1,800 THB speedboat price is a sale price (normal 2,200). (4) Andy's Scuba's basic private boats leave from Rawai Beach without transfers, meals or park fees, and its Domino and Phi Phi prices differ between its own pages. (5) These could not be confirmed and were replaced or removed: the Expedia 7 Islands price (HTTP 429), the backpackbob source (it redirects to the homepage), Love Andaman's TripAdvisor 4.1 score and the 'James Bond Island 6,414 reviews' Google listing.

Open points for the editor:
- Amazing Canoeing and Phuket Sail Tours show no licence number on their sites. Both have long records and Travellers' Choice 2026; ask them for it.
- Simba's private prices cover 2-4 people, and the price per extra person is not published.
- The Phuket Dream Company rate (10 Apr - 31 Oct 2026) and the June Bahtra rate card (valid to March 2026) are low-season or expired.
- Khao Lak Land Discovery's 4,100 THB is listed only until 31 Dec 2026.
- The Krabi 4 Islands park fee is 200 or 400 THB; sources differ.
- Love Andaman's 4,000 THB is the schema price on its James Bond page, which now describes the early program.

Possible small fix outside this list: the hong-by-starlight tip 'A private-charter version of the same trip is sold from 62,750 THB' can add 'for 1-12 people' (checked on the official page). It is not wrong, so it is not filed as a correction.

Pier links: build.mjs links pier cards whose names appear in departsFrom. The departsFrom texts use these names: Boat Lagoon Marina, Royal Phuket Marina, Ao Po Pier, Visit Panwa Pier, Chalong Pier, Bang Rong Pier, Thap Lamu Pier, Nam Khem Pier, Thong Sala Pier, Nopparat Thara Pier, Rawai Beach, Yacht Haven Marina.

Blocked sites: Klook, GetYourGuide, Viator, TripAdvisor and Expedia block scripts (403/429), so ratings come from Google Maps. Phuket Tours Direct (TAT 31/01200) is used only as a price and time source, because its Khai page offers fish feeding.

places-preferences.notes:
FACT-CHECK of places-preferences, 19 Oct 2026. Method: Google Maps place data read directly for every pin (name, address, coordinates, rating, hours, closed flags, review dates), official sites and booking menus, Facebook and Instagram page data, the OSM API and OSRM drive times. All 17 new places and the chalong-bay-rum update are real and open. Nothing is removed.

MAIN FIXES
- Tree Bay: the researcher used a second Google listing ('Hookah lounge viewpoint Kata @Tree Bay Clubhouse', 66 reviews, opens 15:00). The main listing 'Tree Bay Clubhouse' has 2,467 reviews and the official 12:00-23:00 hours, so the place is not new. Real menu prices added. Shisha is illegal in Thailand (TAT) and Phuket officials raided hookah bars in 2026, so there is a warning tip and an optional Safety fact.
- Pensook View Cafe: pin moved 210 m, from the shrine to the cafe's own Google pin on the new side road opposite the shrine (the Facebook address says the same road). Google's main hours show Wednesday open but Phuket 101 says closed, so the text gives both.
- AMP: the 'moving to Bang Tao Laguna' claim was not found anywhere, so it was dropped. The bar is active (Facebook posts to 11 Oct 2026, a vinyl buy-sell-trade event on Sun 25 Oct 2026).
- Removed details with no source: Chokchai/Boonrat per-piece prices, Fruit Fusion 'energy balls' and 'cold-pressed juices', The Kitchen 'sharing plates, skewers', the Doi Thepnimit scooter tip and its '2 km' road (OSM: about 1 km).
- Corrected numbers: ZIMA steaming 1,500-5,000 THB; Yona moored to early April (check-in at Patong 16 Nov 2026 - 4 Apr 2027) and its agent prices valid only to 31 Dec 2026; shorter night drive to Chokchai; Kamala to Chalong Pier 35-45 min.
- Added from official pages: Surf House 90-minute morning session for the same 1,280 THB; Flying Hanuman last admission 16:00; KBA Phuket phone; Doi Thepnimit Google hours 07:00-20:00; Directions for the try-dive now go to the Chalong Pier meeting point.

EXISTING PLACES RE-CHECKED with Google place data (19 Oct 2026): Bangla Road, Rawai Seafood Market, Kruvit Raft, Summore Day Cafe, View Cafe, One Chun, Mee Ton Poe, Lock Tien, Go Benz, Naam Yoi, Mor Mu Dong, Malin Plaza, Natural Restaurant, Renew Sauna, Sabai Massage, Phuket Elephant Sanctuary, Soi Dog, Bangla Boxing Stadium, Blue Elephant, Karon Temple Market, Sunday Walking Street, Naka and Chillva. None closed and no hours changed, so no copies are returned. Note: Google has paused new reviews on Summore Day Cafe after removing suspicious high ratings (now 4.6 from 1,225).

CORRECTION: the Bermudos line in extra.json is confirmed wrong (its last listed party was 10 May 2024, not 2023). The new text also updates Niky's Speakeasy: its Google listing is open (Tue-Sun 20:00-02:00) with a review from 25 Jul 2026, though the website still does not connect.

LEADS NOT ADDED (not fully verified)
- Sedo Record Store, 7 Suthat Rd, Old Town: Google 14:00-23:00, closed Wednesday, 4.6 from 14 reviews; the owner says original first pressings priced by Discogs, plus handcraft clothes; one review says it is mostly a clothes shop, another could not find it. The only walk-in record shop found.
- Niky's Speakeasy & Nightclub, 20 Soi Bang Thao 2 (250 m from AMP): owner text says techno and house DJs. For the events task.
- The 'Bermudos' Google listing at Summerset's address (Si Sunthon) has reviews only from 2022-2023 and says it held Saturday afterparties at Summerset.

NOTE FOR THE MERGE: data/places.json was rewritten at 17:58 today and already holds the researcher's unverified copies of these 17 places. Use these verified copies instead.

places.name: AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 11140459740010937348, 7.9864723, 98.2983699; place data re-read 19 Oct 2026); the official Facebook page gives the same address (9 Landmark, 64 Soi Bang Thao 2); not in OSM
places.gmapsQuery: AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket), Choeng Thale, Phuket
places.bestTime: From about 19:00 for a seat at the bar. Not on Tuesdays.
places.openText: Mon and Wed-Sun 15:00-01:00, closed Tuesday (Google Maps, Oct 2026). Phuket Insider lists 18:00-01:00.
places.feeText: No entry fee. Cocktails about 300 THB (Phuket Insider).
places.gettingThere: 9 Landmark, Soi Bang Thao 2, Choeng Thale, inland from Bang Tao Beach. About 10-15 min from Kamala by car or Grab, 25-35 min from Patong.
places.description: A small vinyl bar in Bang Tao in the style of Japanese listening bars. The owner plays records from a big collection behind the bar on an all-analogue sound system and makes the cocktails. Reviews and posts talk about jazz and soul. It is for listening and talking, not for dancing.
tips: It is small and owner-run. Check Instagram @amplisteningbar for the hours before you go: Google says from 15:00, a 2025 guide says from 18:00.
Closed on Tuesdays (Google Maps).
It holds vinyl buy-sell-trade meetups for collectors (one was set for Sun 25 Oct 2026). Ask if one is on in January.
Catch Beach Club is about 1 km away: sunset at Catch, then records at AMP.
For live jazz nearby: Moonshine on Lagoon Road, 17:00-24:00, closed Monday (Phuket 101, Oct 2026).
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Google Maps place data (read directly): 'AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket)', 9 Landmark, 64 Soi Bang Thao 2, 5.0 from 147 reviews (latest 2 Oct 2026), Mon and Wed-Sun 15:00-01:00, Tue closed, not marked closed. Official Facebook page: same address, phone +66 64 238 8619, 'a vinyl sanctuary with cocktails', jazz posts (Bill Evans), posts up to 11 Oct 2026 and an event 'Buy Sell Trade Vinyl' on Sun 25 Oct 2026. Instagram bio: vinyl on a pure analogue system (45 posts). Phuket Insider: owner Rob (USA), cocktails about 300 THB, 18:00-01:00; the Facebook contact gives another name, so the text names no one. The 'moving to Bang Tao Laguna' note could not be found on the Facebook page or anywhere else, so that tip was dropped. Undiscvered: soulful vinyl bar inspired by Japanese listening bars. Moonshine hours: Phuket 101 (3 Oct 2026). Coords: Google pin only; Catch is 1.0 km away.

places.name: Tree Bay Clubhouse (cliff-top sunset DJ bar, Kata)
places.coordSource: official-site Google Maps link (ll=7.7985786,98.2997012) + google-maps-place, main listing 'Tree Bay Clubhouse' (cid 17239610904049624022, 7.79849, 98.29926), about 50 m apart; a second Google listing, 'Hookah lounge viewpoint Kata @Tree Bay Clubhouse' (cid 12294452350899704734), is 30 m away; not in OSM
places.gmapsQuery: Tree Bay Clubhouse, Kata, Phuket
places.bestTime: Arrive about 17:30 for a table before sunset (about 18:30 in January). The guest DJ sunset sessions on its events page were on Fridays to Sundays.
places.openText: Daily 12:00-23:00, kitchen to 22:00, happy hour 12:00-16:00 (official site and Google Maps, Oct 2026). Pizza from 15:00.
places.feeText: No entry fee. Cocktails 350-480 THB, beer 200-270 THB, pizza from 480 THB. Menu prices add 7% VAT and 10% service (official menu, Oct 2026).
places.gettingThere: 101/13 Moo 1 (Soi Laem Mum Nai), Karon, on the hill road above Kata and Kata Noi, about 300 m from Karon Viewpoint. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 20-30 min from Patong, 5-10 min from Kata.
places.description: A cliff-top bar and restaurant about 270 m above Kata Bay, with wide sunset views over the Andaman Sea. Resident and guest DJs play from afternoon ambient to deep, organic and progressive house in the evening. Wood-fired pizza, seafood and cocktails. A calm, music-first sundowner in the south.
tips: Pair it with Karon Viewpoint, about 300 m away: see the three bays first, then go to Tree Bay for sunset.
Check Instagram @treebayphuket for the DJ of the night. The events page on the website still lists only May-June 2026 sessions.
Saturday has a Golden Hour Brunch from 12:00.
Google also lists it as a hookah lounge. Shisha is illegal in Thailand (TAT), and Phuket officials raided hookah bars in 2026. Do not smoke it.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site (2026): cliff-top bar 270 m above sea level above Kata Beach, daily 12:00-23:00, kitchen to 22:00, happy hour 12:00-16:00, resident and guest DJs 'from afternoon ambient to late-night deep house', Saturday Golden Hour Brunch from noon, wood-fired pizza and seafood, booking on treebay.bookmai.com. Its events page lists only 2026 sunset sessions from 8 May to 28 June (Attgaruda, Poppy, DJ Raf, Anastasia, MBJ, Kameroo; organic, deep and progressive house; Fri-Sun), so the January 2027 DJs are not out. Official menu (Bookmai): cocktails 350 THB, signature cocktails 480, Singha or Chang 200, Heineken 240, Corona 270, Margherita (cheapest pizza) 480, pizza from 15:00, plus 7% VAT and 10% service. Google Maps has two listings: the main 'Tree Bay Clubhouse' (4.7 from 2,467 reviews, 12:00-23:00 daily, reviews to Sep 2026), which the researcher missed, and 'Hookah lounge viewpoint Kata @Tree Bay Clubhouse' (category hookah bar, 4.7 from 66, 15:00-23:00). So the place is not new, and the 15:00 opening was the second listing. Shisha: TAT (4 Nov 2019) says shisha smoking is illegal in Thailand; ASEAN Now (5 Aug 2026) reports hookah-bar raids in Patong (April 2026) and then Rawai. Coords: official map link, main Google pin 50 m.

On Sunday the Walking Street market starts about 200 m away (16:00-22:00), so you can eat there first.
Tip the band if you like the set. There is no cover charge.

Phuket 101 live-music page (updated 3 Oct 2026): 2nd floor of the new VELA building, 20/24 Yaowarat Road at Phang Nga Road, house band plays jazz, soul and blues from around 21:00, grand piano, brass pillars, velvet curtains, long green marble bar, no cover charge, book on weekends, 18:00-24:00, phone 080 245 8945. places.name: Yona Beach Club (floating club in Patong Bay)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place 'Patong Jetty Docking Service' (cid 903688734317498464, 52 Thaweewong Rd, 7.88599, 98.28895), the result Google Maps gives for 'Patong Boat Pier'; the Google pins 'Patong Pier', 'Chokaree Pier' and 'Tender port' are all within 50 m at the south end of Patong Beach. Used as the high-season check-in pier; the club is moored offshore in Patong Bay; not in OSM
places.gmapsQuery: Patong Jetty Docking Service, Thaweewong Road, Patong
places.bestTime: The afternoon session (14:00-21:30) for the DJs and the sunset. Check in by 17:00.
places.openText: Daily. Afternoon session 14:00-21:30, adults 20+, last check-in 17:00. Morning session 9:30-14:00 only on Tue, Thu and Sat (Phuket 101, Aug 2026, and Google Maps). Boats about every 20 minutes.
places.feeText: Passes include the boat and a food and drink credit. Agent prices for 2026 (valid to 31 Dec 2026): general pass 4,000 THB (2,000 credit), ladies pass 2,000 THB (1,000 credit), afternoon Maxi Cabana for 8 people 52,000 THB (36,000 credit). 2027 prices are not out yet.
places.gettingThere: Boats leave from Patong Boat Pier at the south end of Patong Beach from 16 Nov 2026 to 4 Apr 2027 (Royal Phuket Marina the rest of the year). The ride takes about 10 minutes. About 15-25 min from Kamala by car.
places.description: A three-level floating beach club moored in Patong Bay from mid-November to early April, with a 22 m infinity pool, four bars and a rooftop. The afternoon session is 20+ with DJs, mostly house and afro house. Past guests include Amémé and Shimza. A fun group day at sea, not underground.
tips: Be at the pier about 30 minutes before your boat. Last check-in is 17:00. If you are late, your seat can be resold with no refund.
Smart casual: swimwear with a cover-up is fine. No tank tops, sportswear or football shirts. Bring ID (20+).
Rough sea can delay or cancel the boats. Do not plan anything tight after it.
Outside food and drinks, inflatables, balloons and pro camera gear are not allowed. The credit is for food and drinks only.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 29 Aug 2026): 1,200 m2 boat on three levels, 22 m infinity pool, four bars, a restaurant and a rooftop, opened 2021; moored in Patong Bay mid-November to late March with check-in at Patong Boat Pier; shuttle every 20 min, about 10 min; morning 9:30-14:00 (Tue, Thu, Sat), afternoon 14:00-21:30, 20+, DJ; past DJs Amémé, Shimza, Carlita, Themba, Mambo Brothers; dress code checked at the pier; no outside food, inflatables, pro cameras or balloons. Phuket 101 nightclub table: house and afro house. Expedia and Travelocity listings: check-in at Royal Phuket Marina 30 Mar - 15 Nov 2026 and at Patong Boat Pier 16 Nov 2026 - 4 Apr 2027; shuttles 14:00-17:00, last check-in 17:00, late arrival may lose the seat without refund. Google Maps: main 'Yona Beach Club' listing 4.7 from 3,210 reviews, Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun 14:00-21:30, Tue/Thu/Sat 9:30-21:30. Chillpainai (TAT licence 11/07211): general 4,000/2,000 credit, ladies 2,000/1,000, afternoon Maxi Cabana 8 pax 52,000/36,000, valid 16 Jan - 31 Dec 2026, so January 2027 prices may differ. Phuket 101 beach clubs (4 Oct 2026): rough sea can delay or cancel the boats. yonabeach.com blocks bots. Pin: Google pier listing, not confirmed by Yona as the exact boarding point.

places.gmapsQuery: Catch Beach Club, Choeng Thale, Phuket

places.feeText: Beds are booked with food and drink credit of the same value: DJ daybed for 1-3 people 6,000-8,000 THB, cabana for 1-3 people 6,000-8,000 THB, pool sala for 1-2 people 6,000 THB, front-row pool sunbed for 2 people 8,000 THB (official site, Oct 2026).

places.description: One of Phuket's original beach clubs, now on Bang Tao Beach after it left Surin. Daybeds, pool cabanas and a big central bar face the sunset. DJs play house and nu-disco, with After Dark club nights in high season. Stylish and pricey, but a good group day on the sand.
tips: For 8 people, book three DJ daybeds (1-3 people each) online. You eat and drink the full amount.
Book the Friday BBQ or Sunday brunch ahead in January.
AMP, a vinyl listening bar, is about 1 km inland for later in the evening.
Nomad, Maya and Beach Pig on Bang Tao are closed until further notice after a crackdown on illegal beach buildings. Catch, RAVA and Xana are open (Phuket 101, Oct 2026).
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site (modified 5 Oct 2026, 'Festive season 26/27' menu link): daily 07:30-24:00, breakfast 07:30-10:30, day pass 11:00-18:00, lunch and dinner 12:00-22:30, Friday BBQ 19:00-22:00, Sunday brunch 12:00-15:00, After Dark club nights; beds as F&B credit: pool sunbed 2 pax 8,000 (1st row) or 6,000, pool sala 1-2 pax 6,000, cabana 1-3 pax 8,000, chill cabana 6,000, DJ daybed 1-3 pax 8,000 (1st row, 11:00-20:00) or 6,000, seaview daybed 6,000. places.name: Baba Nest (rooftop sunset bar, Sri Panwa)
places.gmapsQuery: Baba Nest, Sri Panwa, Cape Panwa, Phuket
places.bestTime: Book a 17:30-18:00 slot to be there for the sunset (about 18:30 in January).
places.openText: Daily 17:00-20:00. Advance booking only. Closed when it rains (official site).
places.feeText: Outside guests pay a minimum spend of 3,000 THB net per person to confirm the booking. It is not refundable and is used for drinks and food (official site).
places.gettingThere: Inside Sri Panwa resort near the tip of Cape Panwa, 88 Sakdidej Road. About 40-60 min from Kamala, 35-50 min from Patong, 30-40 min from Rawai.
places.description: A small rooftop deck on top of Sri Panwa resort, wrapped by an infinity pool, with 360-degree views over the islands and Phuket's south-east coast. Cocktails, wine and Mexican tapas at sunset. Expensive and short, only 17:00-20:00, but one of the island's most famous sunset spots.
tips: Book early by phone 076 371 008 or on Chope. Tables are held for only 15 minutes.
If it rains, the minimum spend moves to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food at the same resort.
Sri Panwa is the group behind Baba Beach Club in Natai, where Circoloco plays.
Before sunset, swim at Ao Yon Beach or climb the Khao Khad viewpoint tower, both on Cape Panwa.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official page: 'open daily from 5pm - 8pm', advance reservation required, booking line 076-371-008, wrap-around infinity pool and 360-degree views over the islands and the south-east of Phuket, Mexican tapas menu; non-hotel guests pay a mandatory, non-refundable minimum spend of 3,000 THB net per person, closed automatically in rain, the spend can move to Baba Poolclub and Baba Soul Food in bad weather, bookings held 15 minutes. places.name: The Kitchen Patong (late food by Bangla, to 03:00)

tips: No reservations: just walk in (official site).

After Shelter closes at 04:00, Chokchai Dim Sum in Phuket Town opens at 04:00, about 15-20 min away by car at night.
