places.bestTime: A slow afternoon on a recovery day. Entry before 16:00 is cheaper.
places.openText: Tue-Sun 09:00-23:00, closed Monday. A standard visit is 3 hours (official site, Oct 2026).
places.feeText: 3-hour entry: 650 THB from 09:00-16:00, 1,000 THB from 16:00-23:00. Steaming with a steam master 1,500-5,000 THB, Thai massage 500 THB for 60 min (official price list, Oct 2026).
places.gettingThere: 83/14 Rawai, about 5 minutes from Rawai Beach. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 20-30 min from Patong, about 10 min from Kata.
places.description: A wood-fired Russian banya and spa in Rawai, built as a real banya with steam masters and oak brooms. There are ice plunges, a hammam, an onsen pool, a relaxation area and a cafe. Hot-cold rounds here are a good reset after a big weekend, especially if your villa is in the south.
tips: Book a massage or a steaming session with your visit and the entry is 25% cheaper (official site).
Wednesday and Sunday are family days, so children aged 3-13 may be there.
Do not go with alcohol still in your body. Heat and ice water are hard on the heart.
Closed on Mondays. On a Monday use Renew Sauna & Ice Bath in Bang Tao (10:00-23:00).
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site: wood-fired Russian banya and spa complex in Rawai, 83/14 Rawai, 5 minutes from Rawai beach, 09:00-23:00 Tue-Sun, closed Monday, Wed and Sun family days (kids 3-13), steam room with venik brooms and steam masters, ice plunge, hammam, Japanese onsen, pool, massage and a restaurant. Price page: standard visit 3 hours, entry 650 THB (09:00-16:00) or 1,000 THB (16:00-23:00), children 250 THB; steaming programmes run from 1,500 THB (10 min) to 5,000 THB (45 min), not 1,500-3,000 as the researcher wrote; scrub 1,000 THB (20 min) or 500 THB (30 min); Thai massage 500 THB for 60 min; 25% off entry with a massage or steaming booking. Google: 4.7 from 386 reviews, same hours. The pin falls 150 m inside the guide's Nai Harn polygon, within the check's 1 km limit. Coords: Google pin only.

places.name: Bangtao Muay Thai & MMA (group Muay Thai class)
places.gmapsQuery: Bangtao Muay Thai & MMA, Cherngtalay, Phuket
places.bestTime: The 16:00 Muay Thai class on a weekday. It leaves the evening free.
places.openText: Muay Thai classes (90 min): Mon-Fri 08:00 and 16:00, Sat 09:00. Beginner Muay Thai Fundamentals (60 min): Mon-Fri 06:45. Sunday is open gym only (official schedule). Gym Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-16:00 (Google).
places.feeText: Day pass 900 THB per person, valid for all classes that day. One week 4,500-5,000 THB. Private coaching on request (official price page, checked Oct 2026).
places.gettingThere: In Cherngtalay near Bang Tao Beach. About 10-15 min from Kamala, 25-35 min from Patong.
places.description: A big, well-rated Muay Thai and MMA camp in Bang Tao that welcomes beginners and drop-ins. With a day pass the whole group can join a 90-minute Muay Thai class together and use the gym after. A fun, sweaty group morning or afternoon, only 10-15 minutes from Kamala.
tips: Ask for a private class for your group of 8. The price is on request.
Bring a T-shirt, shorts and lots of water. Ask about gloves and hand wraps when you book.
Skip it the morning after a big party. Heat and dehydration are a real risk.
In the south, Soi Ta-iad in Chalong is Phuket's fitness street, with many camps such as Tiger Muay Thai.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Price page (last changed 21 Aug 2025, still live): day pass 900 THB for all classes, 1 week 4,500 (Muay Thai or fitness) to 5,000 THB (all access), MMA week 4,000, private coaching on request. Schedule page (changed 5 Jan 2026), timetable data read: Muay Thai Mon-Fri 08:00 and 16:00, Sat 09:00; Muay Thai Fundamentals Mon-Fri 06:45; 'Muay Thai classes are 90 minutes', Fundamentals classes 1 hour; Sundays open gym. Google: 4.8 from 1,789 reviews, Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-16:00; a review mentions big morning groups in high season with many trainers. Tiger Muay Thai and Soi Ta-iad from the guide's Chalong area text. Coords: Google pin only; it falls 220 m inside the guide's Surin polygon, within the check's 1 km limit.

places.name: Phuket Surf House (FlowRider wave, Patong)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 7758746576964785798, 7.8957069, 98.2964829) + osm-node-4707574192 ('Surf House Patong', amenity=training, 7.895846, 98.296326), 23 m apart
places.gmapsQuery: Phuket Surf House - Patong Beach, Thaweewong Road
places.bestTime: The 09:30-11:00 morning session for the longest ride, or a night session before Bangla Road. The 22:00 session has bar deals.

places.feeText: Shared 60-minute session 1,280 THB per person, with an instructor, practice board and guide rope. The 09:30-11:00 morning session gives 90 minutes for the same price. Private sessions on request (official pricing page).
places.gettingThere: 162/8-11 Thaweewong Road, on the Patong beach road about 250 m north of the Bangla Road corner. About 15-25 min from Kamala.
places.description: An artificial-wave bar on Patong's beach road. You ride a FlowRider wave on a body board or flow board while friends watch from the bar. Instructors hold a rope for beginners. A fun group alternative to jet skis, and it runs until midnight.
tips: Sessions are shared, so you ride in turns with other people.
Ride before you drink, not after. Falls on the wave are hard.
In Kata the similar wave is WAVA Flow Fit Fun (ex Super Surf Kata), 4 Soi Pakbang, 09:00-22:00 (Google Maps).
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official pricing page (changed 23 Feb 2026): standard shared session 1,280 THB for 60 minutes with a professional instructor, practice boards and guiding rope, hourly to midnight (one block says from 10:00, a duplicate from 09:30); 'Mega Jumbo 90' 1,280 THB for 90 minutes, 09:30-11:00 daily (added); 'Standard Jumbo 60' double-pumped 19:00-20:00; 'Crazy Jumbo' from 22:00 with buy-1-get-1 shooters; private session on request; membership 8,800 THB. Google: 'Phuket Surf House - Patong Beach', 4.5 from 601 reviews, daily 09:30-24:00. Kata: Google names 4 Soi Pakbang 'WAVA Flow Fit Fun' (4.7, 588), 09:00-22:00; the Phuket 101 page linked is about Super Surf Kata. places.name: Flying Hanuman (jungle zipline, Kathu)
places.gmapsQuery: Flying Hanuman, Kathu, Phuket
places.bestTime: A morning slot, before the midday heat.
places.openText: Daily 08:00-17:00, last admission 16:00 (official site). Free hotel pickup with all packages.
places.feeText: FH1, 42 platforms and 14 ziplines with a meal: 3,290 THB. FH2, 28 platforms and 7 ziplines: 2,490 THB. FH3 with canopy walk: 1,990 THB. Canopy walk only: 1,500 THB per person (official site, Oct 2026).
places.gettingThere: 89/16 Moo 6, Namtok Kathu, off Wichitsongkram Road in Kathu, between Patong and Phuket Town. About 20-30 min from Kamala or Patong. Hotel pickup is included.
places.description: A zipline park in the old rainforest of Kathu. Guides take groups along platforms high in 100-year-old trees, over sky bridges and down ziplines at up to 60 km/h. The biggest package has 14 ziplines and takes 2-3 hours. An easy, fun half-day for the whole group of 8.
tips: Combo SD3 adds a 30-minute ATV ride for 2,650 THB per person, a simple way to try ATVs with the group.
Wear closed shoes and clothes you can move in. Keep phones in a zip pocket.
Book online a few days ahead in January and choose a morning pickup.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official site (2026, SKY TREK ADVENTURES Co., Ltd.): open daily 08:00-17:00, last admission 16:00 (added), 89/16 Moo 6 Namtok Kathu, Wichitsongkram Road; package cards: FH1 3,290 THB (42 platforms, 14 ziplines, 4 sky bridges, 2-3 h, meal, transfer), FH2 2,490 (28 platforms, 7 ziplines, 3 sky bridges, 1-2 h), FH3 + canopy 1,990 (12 platforms, 3 ziplines, 30 min-1 h), canopy walk 1,500, SD3 FH3 + 30 min ATV 2,650; 'Free hotel pickup included with all packages'; up to 60 km/h, 100-year-old trees, EN 15567 equipment. places.name: Try scuba diving at Racha Yai (Sunrise Divers)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place 'Sunrise Divers Phuket' (cid 1143964270555004102, 7.834997, 98.298055) + osm-node-4772536325 ('Sunrise Divers', 7.834931, 98.29818), 16 m apart; Directions go to the Chalong Pier meeting point (Google 'Chalong Pier Meeting Point', 7.82089, 98.34433), where the boat leaves
places.gmapsQuery: Sunrise Divers Phuket, Patak Road, Karon
places.bestTime: Any day with calm sea. January is the calm season for boat trips. Book a few days ahead.
places.openText: Trips daily. Hotel pickup about 07:15-07:45, boat leaves Chalong Pier at 08:30, back about 15:30 (2 dives) or 18:00 (3 dives). Dive shop Mon-Sat 09:00-17:00, Sun 10:00-15:00 (Google).
places.feeText: Discover Scuba 4,500 THB for 2 dives at Racha Yai, or 5,200 THB for 3 dives at Racha Noi and Yai. Friends who do not dive: 2,000 THB. Gear, insurance, breakfast, lunch and transfers are included (official site).
places.gettingThere: Shop at 269/24 Patak Road, Karon. Free pickup from Patong, Karon and Kata. From Kamala ask about pickup, or take a Grab to Chalong Pier (about 35-45 min in the morning).
places.description: A first dive without a licence. An instructor explains everything on the boat, then takes you down to a maximum of 12 m on the reefs of Racha Yai, about 1.5 hours by boat south of Phuket. It is not a course, just a taster. Friends who do not dive can come on the same boat.
tips: You must be able to swim, feel at ease in water and be healthy. Fill in the 'fit to dive' form before you book.
Do not dive the day after a heavy night. Leave at least 18 hours between diving and a flight (Sunrise Divers).
Certified divers pay 3,000 THB for 2 dives, plus 500 THB for a full gear set.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official site. Discover Scuba page (changed 28 Jun 2026): 4,500 THB for 2 dives at Racha Yai, 5,200 THB for 3 dives at Racha Noi and Yai, equipment, insurance, breakfast, lunch, drinks and hotel transfers from Patong, Karon or Kata included; not a certification; max depth 12 m; daily; itinerary 07:45 pickup, 08:30 Chalong Pier, 10:00 first dive, back about 15:30, 3-dive trips about 18:00; must be able to swim; 'allow 18 hours before flying'. Day-trip page (changed 4 Aug 2025): certified divers 3,000 THB, gear 500 THB, non-divers 2,000 THB, pickup 07:15-07:45. Park fees are not mentioned. Google: 4.8 from 122 reviews; shop 09:00-17:00, Sun 10:00-15:00. Kamala to Chalong Pier: OSRM 29 min free-flow, so 35-45 min with morning traffic (was 40-50). Directions now go to the Chalong Pier meeting point. Coords: Google pin and OSM node 16 m apart.

places.name: eFoil and kitesurf lessons in Rawai (KBA)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 2289071027861189487, 7.7951631, 98.3346066; 16, 26 Wiset Rd, the address on the official site); not in OSM
places.gmapsQuery: KBA Kiteboarding Asia Phuket, Wiset Road, Rawai
places.bestTime: January is good kite season in the south: KBA's own chart rates kitesurfing 'excellent' and eFoil 'good' in January.
places.openText: Daily 08:30-18:00 (Google). Wingfoil, eFoil and SUP all year. Kitesurfing in the east-wind season, November to April (official site).
places.feeText: eFoil: 1-hour trial 3,500 THB, 4-hour course 11,000 THB. Kitesurf: 1-hour trial 2,200 THB, 6-hour beginner course 11,000 THB (official site, checked Oct 2026).
places.gettingThere: 26 Wiset Road, Rawai, near Friendship Beach on Chalong Bay. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 25-30 min from Patong.
places.description: A water-sports school in Rawai for thrills without jet skis. An eFoil is an electric board with a hydrofoil: after a short lesson you glide quietly above the water. In January the east wind also makes south Phuket a good place for a first kitesurf lesson. You must be able to swim.
tips: A 1-hour trial shows if you like it. To ride a kite alone you need about 6 hours of lessons (KBA).
Book on WhatsApp +66 93 480 4040, or call the Phuket centre on +66 81 591 4594 (official site).
KBA's Nai Yang centre is open only April to September, so in January go to Rawai.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official Phuket page (changed 23 Jun 2026): Rawai centre at 16, 26 Wiset Rd, open year-round for wingfoil, eFoil and SUP, kitesurfing in the easterly wind season November-April; Nai Yang centre (74/10 Nai Yang Beach) open April-September; KBA Phuket centre phone +66 81 591 4594, KBA WhatsApp +66 93 480 4040 (the main line on every KBA page). Lesson pages (changed 1 Dec 2025, the same prices for all KBA centres): eFoil 1-hour trial 3,500 THB, 4-hour course 11,000 THB; kitesurf 1-hour trial 2,200 THB, 6-hour beginner course 11,000 THB, 12-hour full course 20,000 THB; swimming required. KBA Phuket season chart (image viewed): January kite 'Excellent', e-foil 'Good'. Google: 4.7 from 135 reviews, daily 08:30-18:00; Friendship Beach Resort is 450 m away, and the guide's Chalong area notes kite schools on Friendship Beach. Where lessons start on the water is not stated, so meet at the centre. Coords: Google pin only.

places.name: Chalong Bay Rum Distillery (The Distillery Phuket)
places.coordSource: official-site-gmaps-link+google-maps-place+osm(photon)
places.gmapsQuery: The Distillery Phuket - Home of Chalong Bay, Chalong, Phuket
places.bestTime: Take the 17:00 tour, then stay for dinner and cocktails in the garden. On Saturdays stay for Social Saturday from 18:00.
places.openText: Daily 11:00-22:00 (new official site thedistilleryphuket.com and Google). Tours daily at 13:00, 15:00, 17:00 and 19:00 (1 hour). Taco Tuesday every Tuesday, Social Saturday every Saturday from 18:00.
places.feeText: Distillery tour 590 THB (with a mojito and a tasting of 9 flavours). Cocktail workshops 990-1,490 THB. Booking required. Taco Tuesday 499 THB, all you can eat. Social Saturday: free entry, BBQ buffet 590 THB.
places.gettingThere: 14/2 Moo 2, Soi Palai 2, Chalong. About 30-40 min from Patong, 15-20 min from Kata.
places.description: The Distillery Phuket, home of Chalong Bay Rum, was started in 2012 by two French expats. They make rum from fresh Thai sugarcane juice, plus Saneha gin and Lanna vodka. The 1-hour tour ends with a tasting and a mojito. The bar and restaurant in the sugarcane garden are good for dinner.
tips: Book on the official site before you go.
Photos are not allowed inside the distillery.
After the tasting, take Grab instead of riding a scooter.
Cocktail workshops start at 12:00 (vodka), 14:00 (rum) and 16:00 (gin).
Saturday group night: Social Saturday from 18:00 has free entry, music bingo and games, and a 590 THB BBQ buffet (official site).
Try the Mojito Flight: 3 flavours for 399 THB, or mix your own at the DIY mojito station for 240 THB.
places.verification: Re-checked 19 Oct 2026. Google now links the venue to a new official site, thedistilleryphuket.com; its FAQ and footer say 'open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM', the same as Google (4.7 from 1,011 reviews, 11:00-22:00 daily), so the old 23:00 closing was dropped. Distillery visit unchanged: 590 THB, daily 13:00/15:00/17:00/19:00, mojito plus a 9-flavour tasting (6 rum, 2 gin, 1 vodka). Cocktail workshops on the new site and on chalongbayrum.com: 990-1,490 THB, daily 12:00 vodka, 14:00 rum, 16:00 gin; the link now points to the new site. Weekly events on the new site: Taco Tuesday (499 THB per person, all-you-can-eat tacos; next 20 Oct 2026) and Social Saturday from 18:00 (free entry, music bingo and games, BBQ buffet 590 THB; next 24 Oct 2026); Mojito Flight 399 THB, DIY mojito 240 THB. Founders and 2012 start from Wikipedia. No-photo rule from Phuket 101 (Nov 2025). Pin 14 m from the official map link, 15 m from Google.

places.name: Wat Doi Thepnimit (hilltop temple view over Patong)
places.coordSource: osm-node-5597525622 ('Wat Doi Thep Nimit Monastery', edited 16 Oct 2026) + google-maps-place 'Wat Doi Thepnimit' (cid 8383725867142626010, 7.899331, 98.3184526), 30 m apart; the paved access road (OSM way 699519569) starts beside Pun Thao Kong Shrine (OSM way 1273355150)
places.gmapsQuery: วัดดอยเทพนิมิต, Patong, Kathu, Phuket
places.bestTime: Late afternoon, then sunset dinner at Pensook View Cafe on the way down.
places.openText: Daily 07:00-20:00 (Google Maps, Oct 2026). The chedi is not always open, but you can walk around it (Phuket 101, Apr 2026).
places.feeText: Free. Parking next to the temple.
places.gettingThere: At the top of the Patong-Kathu hill road, turn off beside Pun Tao Kong Shrine (where drivers honk three times), then follow the paved side road up to the temple, about 1 km. About 10-15 min from Patong, 15-25 min from Kamala.
places.description: A quiet hilltop temple above Patong with a wide view over the whole bay. Its white chedi, in a north-eastern Thai style, is ringed by colourful seven-headed naga. You can spot it from the beach. Monks and nuns meditate and sweep here. A calm break from Bangla Road.
tips: Cover shoulders and knees. It is a working temple.
Check the name in Google Maps: Wat Thepnimit, between Phuket Town and Chalong, is a different temple.
Phuket 101 calls Patong Hill 'notoriously dangerous'. Go by car or Grab if you are new to scooters.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 temple page (updated 4 Apr 2026): free; the new road to it starts at the top of 'the notoriously dangerous Patong Hill', next to the Chinese shrine where everyone honks three times; 'nicely paved for a couple of kilometres'; ample parking; white pagoda in Pra Tat Pra Nom style with colourful seven-headed naga (the photos show naga balustrades around it); panoramic view over Patong Beach; 'you can see its iconic white pagoda from the beach'; pagoda area not always open; monks and nuns; do not confuse with Wat Thepnimit. Phuket 101 gives no scooter advice, so that tip was replaced. Google Maps (not checked by the researcher): 'Wat Doi Thepnimit', 4.8 from 480 reviews, daily 07:00-20:00, pin 30 m from OSM. OpenStreetMap: the concrete road from the shrine to the temple is about 0.7-0.9 km, so 'about 2 km' was changed to 'about 1 km'.

places.name: Pensook View Cafe (Thai food with a Patong Bay view)
places.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 3306900368026774723, 7.9043537, 98.3205573; owner-managed, the listing Phuket 101 links), on the OSM 'New road' (way 1219848054) that leaves the main road opposite Pun Thao Kong Shrine (OSM way 1273355150), about 180 m along it; the Facebook address is 'ถนนตัดใหม่ หน้าศาลปุ้นเถ๋ากง' (new road, in front of the shrine). The old pin (the shrine itself) was 210 m away
places.gmapsQuery: Pensook View Cafe, Wichitsongkram Road, Kathu, Phuket
places.bestTime: Come about an hour before sunset (about 18:30 in January) for a sea-facing table, and stay for the half hour after, when Patong lights up.
places.openText: 11:00-22:00, closed Wednesday (Phuket 101, Sep 2026, and Google's lunch hours). Google's main hours say 10:30-22:00 every day, so call 087 884 1524 before a Wednesday visit.
places.feeText: Local restaurant prices. A menu with prices is not published online.
places.gettingThere: At the top of the Patong-Kathu hill road, coming from Patong, turn left onto the new concrete side road opposite Pun Tao Kong Shrine. The cafe is a short way along it. Park by the road. About 10 min from Patong, 15-20 min from Kamala.
places.description: A local Southern Thai restaurant on terraces cut into Patong Hill, with the whole of Patong Bay below. Try the sour orange curry with prawns, squid in black ink or the prawn chilli dip with vegetables. Thatched roofs, rattan chairs and room for a group of 8. Best at sunset and just after.
tips: Google Maps routes get confused on this hill. Look for Pun Tao Kong Shrine and take the side road across from it.
When you leave, do not cross the main road. Turn left downhill and make a U-turn.
Staff ask how spicy you want each dish, so say mild if you need it.
Wat Doi Thepnimit, a hilltop temple with a view, is a short drive from the same shrine.
places.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 page (updated 20 Sep 2026): Pensook View (เพ็ญสุข วิว), Southern Thai, on the Patong Hill road opposite the Pun Tao Kong Shrine, entrance on your left coming from Patong, 'Google Maps gets confused on this stretch', 11:00-22:00, closed Wednesday, phone 087 884 1524, roadside parking, turn left and U-turn when leaving, the dishes, terraces under thatch on bamboo frames, rattan armchairs, 'a group of ten is not a problem', staff ask how spicy. Google Maps place data (owner-managed): 4.6 from 203 reviews, main hours 10:30-22:00 every day, but its separate 'Lunch' hours list Wednesday as closed (11:00-22:00 other days, Thu to 23:00). Facebook page (posts to 18 Oct 2026): address 'new road, in front of Pun Thao Kong Shrine', phone +66 87 884 1524. OSM shows a new concrete road that leaves the main road (Route 4029) opposite the shrine; the Google pin sits on it 180 m in. The researcher pinned the shrine (210 m away, over the 150 m limit), so the pin moved to Google's. Prices are not published.

facts.title: Shisha (hookah) is illegal too
facts.text: Shisha and electronic shisha are illegal in Thailand, the same as vapes (Tourism Authority of Thailand). In 2026 officials raided hookah bars in Patong and then in Rawai. Some bars and Google listings still offer it. Say no.

extra.notes:
ADVERSARIAL CHECK of critic-additions, 19 Oct 2026. All 5 items are real and stay, with fixes. Nothing removed. Sources checked live: the Lomprayah booking system (quota and boat-info data) for 11, 12, 19-23 Jan and 20 Feb 2027; the Seatran Discovery engine (Seatran, Boonsiri, Songserm) for 11, 19, 20, 21 and 23 Jan 2027; Google Maps place data for every pin; OSM (map API, Nominatim); OSRM car and foot routes; phangan.events REST data; the Megatix event and sessions APIs; Love Andaman's official pages; and Phuket 101, TAT, Visit Thailand Today, Inside Samui and phuketferry.com.

MAIN FIXES
1. Sédo Izikura: status changed from recurring to unconfirmed. phangan.events listed no Sédo nights from Nov 2025 to Apr 2026, while it posted 202 other Phuket listings in that time. The tip saying 'Saturday 00:00 = Friday night' was a guess: some nights were Saturday nights (26 Sep, 3 Oct). The claim 'most weekends since mid-2025' was not supported.
2. Tree Secret Sound Garden: renamed (the flyers say 'Tree Secret Sound Garden'). The old gmapsQuery opened SOHO Bar. Details that came only from reviews (red lights, hidden entrance, cannabis shop) were taken out.
3. Mae Haad Pier: the '1-5 seats left' tip misread the online allotment. The 12:30 speedboat also shows 5 seats on 20 Feb 2027. Added Lomprayah's direct Thong Sala - Koh Nang Yuan tickets (08:30 out, 15:00 back, 600 THB).
4. Thong Sala Pier: the query 'Thong Sala Pier, Koh Phangan' opens Google's listing at the Songserm pier, 300 m away. Added a Koh Nang Yuan row. The Songserm Koh Tao ferry leaves from its own pier. Bangrak 17:05 confirmed on 12, 20 and 23 Jan.
5. Visit Panwa Pier: every time and price confirmed (Love Andaman, Megatix sessions, OSRM). Only small wording fixes.

FOR THE MERGE (tools/merge-islands-events.mjs)
- gmapsQuery, name and coordSource are not in PLACE_TAKE. So the critic-additions copy of thong-sala-pier will not change its gmapsQuery: it needs an AFTER hook.
- The koh-tao-nang-yuan and koh-yao-yai hooks move lat/lng but leave gmapsQuery on the piers. Change gmapsQuery too (see corrections).
- Ang Thong: an AFTER hook should move tour-ang-thong-from-phangan to the Emerald Lake viewpoint (9.65752, 99.66624), so the two pins stop overlapping.
- Texts in TEXT_FIX / INFO_FIX that differ from the reviewed corrections:
  - seatran-bangrak: the critic's text makes the description 343 characters; use the shorter one.
  - rassada: the critic's tip is 187 characters; use the 174-character one.
  - 'Day trip or overnight': write '1 h 30 min'.
  - 'Last boats': add 'at Thong Sala 18:10'.
  - Solo fact: use one bracket pair instead of two.
- The eventsIntro and eventsFooter fixes are not in the script yet.
- New correction: koh-tao-nang-yuan gettingThere (Songserm).

NOT CHANGED, FOR THE EDITOR
- On the bangrak-big-buddha card, Lomprayah's 12:15 Bangrak - Thong Sala boat costs 250 THB, not 350 (19 Jan 2027).
- The koh-lanta and koh-phi-phi-don-night pins sit 50-58 m from the Saladan and Tonsai pier cards. That is a design choice, so they stay.
- The overlap between the 'Ferries and boats' and 'Choosing a boat tour' Info sections is an editorial call.

events.name: Sédo Izikura (late underground sessions, Phuket Old Town)
events.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Sédo Izikura' (Japanese restaurant, plus code V9QV+8CW, Talat Yai); 'Sédo Record Store, 7 Suthat Rd' has the same phone and a pin 1 m away; OSM reverse geocode: Suthat Road, Phuket Old Town (re-checked 19 Oct 2026)

events.venue: Sédo Izikura, 7 Suthat Road, Phuket Old Town (same spot as Sédo Record Store)
events.description: A small Japanese home-cooking restaurant and record store in Phuket Old Town that hosts underground DJ nights. Local crews play minimal, house and tech house, often from midnight to about 05:00, and Tuesday is an open-deck night. Entry is free or 200 THB. Tiny, local and very late.
events.timeText: Weekend sessions start between 21:00 and 00:00 on a Friday or Saturday night and run to about 02:00-06:00. Tuesday open decks start at about 20:00-23:00. Google lists the restaurant 14:00-23:00, closed Wednesday.
events.priceText: Free or 200 THB (Sep-Oct 2026 listings).
events.recurrence: Most weekends in Sep-Oct 2026 (Back Yard 5 and 12 Sep, After Burn 26 Sep, Nissa Takeover 3 Oct, Local Drive 10 Oct, Guest Class+ 17 Oct) and open decks on Tue 6, 13 and 20 Oct. Also nights in May-Jun 2026 and Jul-Oct 2025. None were listed from Nov 2025 to Apr 2026 (the last high season), so January 2027 is not sure.
tips: Flyers show a date and 'start 00:00'. That can mean the night before that date, so check Instagram @sedoizikura or phangan.events (Phuket) that week.
From Shelter in Patong it is 16 km, about 20 min by car at night. Sessions often run to 05:00-06:00, so it can be your last stop. Courage Bar is 2 km away.
From Kamala it is 22 km, about 25-35 min at night. Use Grab or Bolt both ways.
Bring cash and ID. Japanese home cooking is served during the sessions.
events.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phangan.events REST data (location 'Sedo Izikura', 21 listings, and the Phuket region list): DJ Fishmonger (Tue 15 Jul 2025), The Vagabond (Fri 29 Aug 2025, minimal and tech house), DJ Open Deck 'every Tuesday' from Sep 2025, Local Drive (Fri 24 Oct 2025), Back Yard (Sat 16 May and 13 Jun 2026, 'hypnotic minimal beats'), Guest Class+ (Sat 6 Jun 2026, vinyl), After Burn (Sat 20 Jun 2026, free); then Back Yard 5 and 12 Sep (00:00-05:00, entered as the night of Friday into Saturday), After Burn Sat 26 Sep (21:00-02:00, free), Nissa Takeover Sat 3 Oct (23:59-06:00, a Saturday night), Local Drive 10 Oct and Guest Class+ 17 Oct (00:00-06:00, 200 THB, entered as the Friday night), open decks Tue 6 Oct (22:00), 13 Oct (23:00) and 20 Oct (20:00, posted 19 Oct). events.name: Tree Secret Sound Garden: free techno and psy nights (Thong Sala)
events.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Sound Garden' (bar, 79/21 M.1 Soi Krung Thai, Thong Sala); the 'Tree Secret' listing at the same address is 5 m away; 440-460 m on foot from the Thong Sala pier (OSRM foot route), re-checked 19 Oct 2026

events.description: A small garden bar on Soi Krung Thai in Thong Sala, about 6 minutes on foot from the pier. It has free nights most weeks: techno with resident DJ Annabelle (often on Tuesdays), Psy Garden psytrance on many Saturdays, and minimal 'Garden of Sins' nights. Small and local.
events.timeText: Nights start at about 18:00-21:00 and end at about 00:00-02:00. Google lists the bar 14:00-01:00 every day.
events.priceText: Free entry on most 2026 listings; none showed a ticket price.
events.recurrence: One to three nights a week; the program changes. 2026: Tuesday techno nights with resident Annabelle (May to Aug; in late Sep some Tuesdays were drum and bass or live percussion), Psy Garden on many Saturdays, Garden of Sins on some Mondays and Fridays. January 2027 nights are not posted yet.
tips: About 6 minutes on foot from Thong Sala pier: an easy warm-up on Tue 19 Jan, the day you land, before OXA.
Check phangan.events (venue: Tree Secret (Sound Garden)) or the Phangan Party Guide on Telegram for the week's nights.
Cannabis is for medical use with a Thai prescription only (since June 2025). Do not buy or smoke it at parties.

places.description: Koh Tao's main port, in Mae Haad village on the west coast. All boats from Koh Phangan, Samui and Chumphon land here. Lomprayah uses the main pier; Boonsiri and Songserm have their own small piers about 200 m south, so check your ticket. Sairee Beach, with the bars, starts about 600 m north.

places.gettingThere: Boat only: about 1-1.5 h from Thong Sala on Koh Phangan, or 1.5-2 h from Bangrak on Samui. On Koh Tao, songthaew taxis wait at the pier; Sairee Beach starts about 600 m north.

Boonsiri and Songserm leave from their own piers, about 200 m south of the main pier. Read the pier name on your ticket and be there 30 minutes early.
Day trip from Koh Phangan: the 08:30 Lomprayah (Koh Tao 09:30, Koh Nang Yuan 09:45), back on the 15:30 catamaran or the 16:30 ferry.
Lomprayah also sells Thong Sala - Koh Nang Yuan direct: 08:30 out, 15:00 back from Nang Yuan (Thong Sala 16:45), 600 THB each way.
Only a few seats on the 12:30 speedboat are sold online (5 or fewer on every date checked). Book it early or take a catamaran.
